name: fin_foldl_const
statement:
lemma fin_foldl_const {T : Type*} (n : ℕ) (c : T) :
  Fin.foldl n (fun acc _k => acc) c = c
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero =>
    simp [Fin.foldl_zero]
  | succ n ih =>
    simp [Fin.foldl_succ, ih]

name: foldl_sum_val_bound
statement:
lemma foldl_sum_val_bound {p : ℕ} [Fact p.Prime] {ops : ℕ} (f : Fin ops → ZMod p) (M : ℕ)
    (h_bound : ∀ j : Fin ops, (f j).val ≤ M) (h_no_overflow : ops * M < p) :
    (Fin.foldl ops (fun sum j => sum + f j) 0).val ≤ ops * M
proof:
:= by
  
  induction ops with
  | zero =>
    simp only [Fin.foldl_zero, ZMod.val_zero, zero_mul, le_refl]
  | succ k ih =>
    
    rw [Fin.foldl_succ_last]
    
    have h_partial_bound := ih (fun j => f j.castSucc)
                               (fun j => h_bound j.castSucc)
                               (by
                                 
                                 apply Nat.lt_of_le_of_lt _ h_no_overflow
                                 apply Nat.mul_le_mul_right
                                 exact Nat.le_succ k)

    
    have h_add_lt : (Fin.foldl k (fun sum j => sum + f j.castSucc) 0).val + (f (Fin.last k)).val < p := by
      apply Nat.lt_of_le_of_lt
      · apply Nat.add_le_add h_partial_bound (h_bound (Fin.last k))
      · rw [← Nat.succ_mul]
        exact h_no_overflow

    
    rw [ZMod.val_add_of_lt h_add_lt]
    
    
    
    have h_succ : (k + 1) * M = k * M + M := by rw [Nat.succ_mul]
    rw [h_succ]
    apply Nat.add_le_add h_partial_bound (h_bound (Fin.last k))

name: foldl_factor_const
statement:
lemma foldl_factor_const {α : Type*} [CommSemiring α] {n : ℕ} (f : Fin n → α) (c : α) (init : α) :
    Fin.foldl n (fun acc i => acc + f i * c) init =
    init + c * Fin.foldl n (fun acc i => acc + f i) 0
proof:
:= by
  induction n generalizing init with
  | zero => simp [Fin.foldl_zero]
  | succ m ih =>
    
    simp only [Fin.foldl_succ_last]
    
    have h_eq : Fin.foldl m (fun x1 x2 => x1 + f x2.castSucc * c) init =
                Fin.foldl m (fun x1 x2 => x1 + (f ∘ Fin.castSucc) x2 * c) init := by
      congr
    rw [h_eq]
    rw [ih (f ∘ Fin.castSucc)]
    
    have h_rhs : Fin.foldl m (fun x1 x2 => x1 + f x2.castSucc) 0 =
                 Fin.foldl m (fun x1 x2 => x1 + (f ∘ Fin.castSucc) x2) 0 := by
      congr
    rw [← h_rhs]
    
    
    rw [mul_add, add_assoc]
    congr 1
    rw [mul_comm c (f (Fin.last m)), add_comm]

name: foldl_factor_init
statement:
lemma foldl_factor_init {α : Type*} [CommSemiring α] {n : ℕ} (f : Fin n → α) (init : α) :
    Fin.foldl n (fun acc i => acc + f i) init =
    init + Fin.foldl n (fun acc i => acc + f i) 0
proof:
:= by
  have hh := (foldl_factor_const f 1 init)
  simp_all only [mul_one, one_mul]

name: foldl_eq_sum_range
statement:
lemma foldl_eq_sum_range {α : Type*} [AddCommMonoid α] : ∀ (n' : ℕ) (f' : Fin n' → α),
    Fin.foldl n' (fun acc i => acc + f' i) 0 = ∑ i ∈ Finset.range n', if h : i < n' then f' ⟨i, h⟩ else 0
proof:
:= by
  intro n' f'
  induction n' with
  | zero =>
    simp [Fin.foldl_zero, Finset.range_zero]
  | succ n'' ih =>
    rw [Fin.foldl_succ_last]
    rw [Finset.sum_range_succ]
    simp only [ih]
    
    congr 1
    
    · apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro i hi
      simp only [Finset.mem_range] at hi
      simp only [Fin.castSucc_mk]
      simp only [hi]
      simp only [↓reduceDIte]
      have hi' : i < n'' + 1 := by omega
      simp only [hi', ↓reduceDIte]
    · 
      simp only [Fin.last, Nat.lt_succ_self, dif_pos]

name: foldl_to_sum
statement:
lemma foldl_to_sum {α : Type*} [AddCommMonoid α] : ∀ (n' : ℕ) (f' : Fin n' → α),
    Fin.foldl n' (fun acc i => acc + f' i) 0 = ∑ i : Fin n', f' i
proof:
:= by
  intro n' f'
  simp only [Finset.sum_fin_eq_sum_range]
  exact foldl_eq_sum_range n' f'

name: foldl_to_sum_init_value
statement: lemma foldl_to_sum_init_value {α : Type*} [CommSemiring α] : ∀ init (n' : ℕ) (f' : Fin n' → α), Fin.foldl n' (fun acc i => acc + f' i) init = init + ∑ i : Fin n', f' i
proof:
:= by
  intro init n' f'
  rw [foldl_factor_init]
  simp only [foldl_to_sum]

name: sum_interchange
statement:
lemma sum_interchange {α : Type*} [CommSemiring α] {n ops : ℕ} (f : Fin ops → Fin n → α) (g : ℕ → α) :
    Fin.foldl n (fun acc k => acc + g k.val *
      Fin.foldl ops (fun acc' j => acc' + f j k) 0) 0 =
    Fin.foldl ops (fun acc j => acc +
      Fin.foldl n (fun acc' k => acc' + f j k * g k.val) 0) 0
proof:
:= by
  simp only [foldl_to_sum, Finset.mul_sum]
  
  
  rw [Finset.sum_comm]
  
  simp only [mul_comm]

name: foldl_split_mul_add_distrib
statement:
lemma foldl_split_mul_add_distrib {α : Type*} [CommRing α] {n : ℕ} (f : Fin 2 → Fin n → α) (g : ℕ → α) :
    Fin.foldl n (fun acc i => acc + f 0 i * g i.val - f 1 i * g i.val) (2^n : α) =
    (Fin.foldl n (fun acc' i => acc' + f 0 i * g i.val) 0) +
    2^n -
    (Fin.foldl n (fun acc' i => acc' + f 1 i * g i.val) 0)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [add_sub_assoc]
  simp only [foldl_to_sum_init_value]
  simp only [Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
  grind

name: finset_ssubset_univ_of_not_mem
statement:
lemma finset_ssubset_univ_of_not_mem {α : Type*} [Fintype α] (s : Finset α) (x : α)
    (h : x ∉ s) :
    s ⊂ Finset.univ
proof:
:= by
  rw [Finset.ssubset_univ_iff]
  intro h_eq_univ
  have : x ∈ Finset.univ := Finset.mem_univ x
  rw [← h_eq_univ] at this
  exact h this

name: sum_decrease
statement:
lemma sum_decrease {α : Type*} [Fintype α] [DecidableEq α] (f g : α → ℕ) (a : α)
    (h_a_decrease : g a < f a)
    (h_others_le : ∀ x, g x ≤ f x) :
    ∑ x : α, g x < ∑ x : α, f x
proof:
:= by
  have h1 : ∑ x : α, f x = f a + ∑ x ∈ Finset.univ.erase a, f x := by
    rw [← Finset.sum_erase_add _ _ (Finset.mem_univ a)]
    omega
  have h2 : ∑ x : α, g x = g a + ∑ x ∈ Finset.univ.erase a, g x := by
    rw [← Finset.sum_erase_add _ _ (Finset.mem_univ a)]
    omega
  rw [h1, h2]
  
  
  have h_rest : ∑ x ∈ Finset.univ.erase a, g x ≤ ∑ x ∈ Finset.univ.erase a, f x := by
    apply Finset.sum_le_sum
    intro x _
    exact h_others_le x
  omega

name: path_has_transition
statement:
lemma path_has_transition {S : Type*} [DecidableEq S] (path : List S)
    (h_len : path.length ≥ 2) :
    ∃ (t : Transition S), t ∈ path.zip path.tail
proof:
:= by
  cases path with
  | nil => simp at h_len
  | cons hd tl =>
    cases tl with
    | nil => simp at h_len
    | cons hd2 tl2 =>
      refine ⟨(hd, hd2), ?_⟩
      simp only [List.tail_cons, List.zip_cons_cons]
      exact List.mem_cons_self ..

name: containsPath_has_positive_transition
statement:
lemma containsPath_has_positive_transition (R : Run S) (path : List S)
    (h_contains : R.containsPath path) (t : Transition S)
    (h_in : t ∈ path.zip path.tail) :
    R t > 0
proof:
:= by
  have h_count_pos : countTransitionInPath t path > 0 := by
    unfold countTransitionInPath
    exact List.count_pos_iff.mpr h_in
  have h_bound := h_contains t
  omega

name: zip_drop_sublist
statement:
lemma zip_drop_sublist (l : List S) (n : ℕ) :
    ((l.drop n).zip (l.drop (n + 1))).Sublist (l.zip l.tail)
proof:
:= by
  induction n generalizing l with
  | zero =>
    simp [List.drop, List.tail]
  | succ n' ih =>
    cases l with
    | nil => simp
    | cons h t =>
      simp only [List.drop_succ_cons, List.tail_cons]
      have h_sub := ih t
      refine List.Sublist.trans h_sub ?_
      cases t with
      | nil => simp
      | cons t0 ts =>
        rw [List.tail_cons]
        simp [List.zip_cons_cons]

name: containsPath_drop
statement:
lemma containsPath_drop (R : Run S) (path : List S) (n : ℕ)
    (h_contains : R.containsPath path) :
    R.containsPath (path.drop n)
proof:
:= by
  unfold Run.containsPath countTransitionInPath at h_contains ⊢
  intro t
  have h_tail_drop : (path.drop n).tail = path.drop (n + 1) := List.tail_drop
  rw [h_tail_drop]
  have h_sublist := zip_drop_sublist path n
  have h_count_le : List.count t ((path.drop n).zip (path.drop (n + 1))) ≤
      List.count t (path.zip path.tail) := List.Sublist.count_le t h_sublist
  have h_original := h_contains t
  omega

name: zip_take_sublist
statement:
lemma zip_take_sublist (l1 l2 : List S) (n m : ℕ) :
    ((l1.take n).zip (l2.take m)).Sublist (l1.zip l2)
proof:
:= by
  cases n with
  | zero => simp
  | succ n' =>
    cases m with
    | zero => simp
    | succ m' =>
      cases l1 with
      | nil => simp
      | cons h1 t1 =>
        cases l2 with
        | nil => simp
        | cons h2 t2 =>
          simp only [List.take_succ_cons, List.zip_cons_cons]
          exact List.Sublist.cons_cons (h1, h2) (zip_take_sublist t1 t2 n' m')

name: tail_take
statement:
lemma tail_take {α : Type*} (l : List α) (n : ℕ) :
    (l.take n).tail = (l.tail).take (n - 1)
proof:
:= by
  cases n with
  | zero => simp
  | succ n' =>
    cases l with
    | nil => simp
    | cons hd tl =>
      simp [List.take, List.tail]

name: containsPath_take
statement:
lemma containsPath_take (R : Run S) (path : List S) (n : ℕ)
    (h_contains : R.containsPath path) :
    R.containsPath (path.take n)
proof:
:= by
  unfold Run.containsPath countTransitionInPath at h_contains ⊢
  intro t
  rw [tail_take]
  
  have h_sublist := zip_take_sublist path path.tail n (n - 1)
  have h_count_le : List.count t ((path.take n).zip ((path.tail).take (n - 1))) ≤
      List.count t (path.zip path.tail) := List.Sublist.count_le t h_sublist
  have h_original := h_contains t
  omega

name: drop_take_length_ge_two
statement:
lemma drop_take_length_ge_two {α : Type*} (path : List α) (n m : Fin path.length)
    (h_n_lt_m : n < m) :
    ((path.drop n.val).take (m.val - n.val + 1)).length ≥ 2
proof:
:= by
  rw [List.length_take, List.length_drop]
  have h_diff : m.val - n.val ≥ 1 := by
    have : (n : ℕ) < (m : ℕ) := h_n_lt_m
    omega
  
  
  
  have : m.val - n.val + 1 ≤ path.length - n.val := by omega
  simp only [Nat.min_eq_left this, ge_iff_le, Nat.reduceLeDiff]
  omega

name: getLast_drop_take
statement:
lemma getLast_drop_take {α : Type*} (path : List α) (n k : ℕ)
    (h_n_lt : n < path.length)
    (h_bound : n + k ≤ path.length)
    (h_k_pos : k > 0) :
    ((path.drop n).take k).getLast? = path[n + k - 1]?
proof:
:= by
  have h_cycle_length : ((path.drop n).take k).length = k := by
    rw [List.length_take, List.length_drop]
    have : k ≤ path.length - n := by omega
    simp [Nat.min_eq_left this]
  rw [List.getLast?_eq_getElem?, h_cycle_length]
  have h_idx : k - 1 < k := by omega
  simp only [h_idx, ↓reduceIte, List.getElem?_take, List.getElem?_drop]
  have : n + (k - 1) = n + k - 1 := by omega
  rw [this]

name: drop_take_cycle_same_endpoints
statement:
lemma drop_take_cycle_same_endpoints (path : List S) (x : S) (n m : Fin path.length)
    (h_n_lt_m : n < m)
    (h_x_at_n : path[n] = x)
    (h_x_at_m : path[m] = x) :
    ((path.drop n.val).take (m.val - n.val + 1)).head? =
    ((path.drop n.val).take (m.val - n.val + 1)).getLast?
proof:
:= by
  have h_n_lt_len : n.val < path.length := n.isLt
  have h_m_lt_len : m.val < path.length := m.isLt
  have h_head : ((path.drop n.val).take (m.val - n.val + 1)).head? = some x := by
    rw [List.head?_take]
    have h_take_nonzero : m.val - n.val + 1 ≠ 0 := by omega
    simp only [if_neg h_take_nonzero]
    rw [List.head?_drop]
    have h_n_in_bounds : n.val < path.length := h_n_lt_len
    aesop
  have h_last : ((path.drop n.val).take (m.val - n.val + 1)).getLast? = some x := by
    rw [getLast_drop_take path n.val (m.val - n.val + 1) h_n_lt_len (by omega) (by omega)]
    have : n.val + (m.val - n.val + 1) - 1 = m.val := by omega
    simp only [this]
    aesop
  rw [h_head, h_last]

name: containsPath_drop_take
statement:
lemma containsPath_drop_take (R : Run S) (path : List S) (n m : ℕ)
    (h_contains : R.containsPath path) :
    R.containsPath ((path.drop n).take m)
proof:
:= by
  have h_after_drop : R.containsPath (path.drop n) :=
    containsPath_drop R path n h_contains
  exact containsPath_take R (path.drop n) m h_after_drop

name: acyclic_containsPath_nodup
statement:
lemma acyclic_containsPath_nodup (R : Run S) (path : List S)
    (h_acyclic : R.isAcyclic)
    (h_contains : R.containsPath path) :
    path.Nodup
proof:
:= by
  
  by_contra h_dup
  
  rw [← List.exists_duplicate_iff_not_nodup] at h_dup
  obtain ⟨x, h_duplicate⟩ := h_dup
  
  rw [List.duplicate_iff_exists_distinct_get] at h_duplicate
  obtain ⟨n, m, h_n_lt_m, h_x_at_n, h_x_at_m⟩ := h_duplicate
  
  
  
  let cycle := (path.drop n.val).take (m.val - n.val + 1)
  
  have h_n_lt_len : n.val < path.length := n.isLt
  have h_m_lt_len : m.val < path.length := m.isLt
  have h_cycle_len := drop_take_length_ge_two path n m h_n_lt_m
  have h_cycle_starts_ends_with_x : cycle.head? = cycle.getLast? :=
    drop_take_cycle_same_endpoints path x n m h_n_lt_m h_x_at_n.symm h_x_at_m.symm
  have h_cycle_contained : R.containsPath cycle :=
    containsPath_drop_take R path n.val (m.val - n.val + 1) h_contains
  
  unfold Run.isAcyclic Run.hasCycle at h_acyclic
  push Not at h_acyclic
  apply h_acyclic cycle h_cycle_len h_cycle_starts_ends_with_x h_cycle_contained

name: countTransitionInPath_append_singleton
statement:
lemma countTransitionInPath_append_singleton (path : List S) (x y : S)
    (h_nonempty : path ≠ [])
    (h_last : path.getLast? = some x)
    (h_not_in : (x, y) ∉ path.zip path.tail) :
    countTransitionInPath (x, y) (path ++ [y]) = 1
proof:
:= by
  unfold countTransitionInPath
  obtain ⟨h, t', rfl⟩ := List.exists_cons_of_ne_nil h_nonempty
  rw [List.cons_append, List.tail_cons]
  induction t' generalizing h with
  | nil =>
    simp
    have : x = h := by simp at h_last; exact h_last.symm
    simp [this]
  | cons h2 t2 ih =>
    simp only [List.cons_append, List.zip_cons_cons]
    by_cases h_eq : (h, h2) = (x, y)
    · aesop
    · simp [h_eq]
      
      apply ih
      · simp
      · rw [← List.getLast?_cons_cons]; exact h_last
      · rw [List.tail_cons, List.zip_cons_cons] at h_not_in
        aesop

name: countTransitionInPath_append_singleton_other
statement:
lemma countTransitionInPath_append_singleton_other (path : List S) (x y : S) (t : Transition S)
    (h_nonempty : path ≠ [])
    (h_last : path.getLast? = some x)
    (h_ne : t ≠ (x, y)) :
    countTransitionInPath t (path ++ [y]) = countTransitionInPath t path
proof:
:= by
  unfold countTransitionInPath
  obtain ⟨h, t', rfl⟩ := List.exists_cons_of_ne_nil h_nonempty
  rw [List.cons_append, List.tail_cons]
  induction t' generalizing h with
  | nil =>
    simp at h_last
    subst h_last
    simp [Ne.symm h_ne]
  | cons h2 t2 ih =>
    rw [List.tail_cons]
    simp only [List.cons_append, List.zip_cons_cons]
    
    have h_ih := ih h2 (by simp) (by rw [← List.getLast?_cons_cons]; exact h_last)
    rw [List.tail_cons] at h_ih
    rw [List.count_cons, List.count_cons, h_ih]

name: mem_of_mem_zip_fst
statement:
lemma mem_of_mem_zip_fst {α β : Type*} (l1 : List α) (l2 : List β) (a : α) (b : β) :
    (a, b) ∈ l1.zip l2 → a ∈ l1
proof:
:= by
  intro h_mem
  induction l1 generalizing l2 with
  | nil => simp at h_mem
  | cons h1 t1 ih =>
    cases l2 with
    | nil => simp at h_mem
    | cons h2 t2 =>
      simp only [List.zip_cons_cons, List.mem_cons, Prod.mk.injEq] at h_mem
      cases h_mem with
      | inl h_eq =>
        have : a = h1 := h_eq.1
        simp [this]
      | inr h_rest =>
        have : a ∈ t1 := ih t2 h_rest
        exact List.mem_cons_of_mem h1 this

name: head_pair_not_in_tail_zip
statement:
lemma head_pair_not_in_tail_zip {α : Type*} [DecidableEq α] (h : α) (t : List α)
    (h_not_in : h ∉ t) :
    ∀ h2, (h, h2) ∉ t.zip t.tail
proof:
:= by
  intro h2
  cases t with
  | nil => simp
  | cons h2' t2 =>
    intro h_contra
    cases t2 with
    | nil => simp [List.zip] at h_contra
    | cons h3 t3 =>
      rw [List.tail_cons, List.zip_cons_cons, List.mem_cons] at h_contra
      cases h_contra with
      | inl h_eq =>
        
        have : h = h2' := (Prod.mk_inj.mp h_eq).1
        subst this
        
        simp at h_not_in
      | inr h_rest =>
        
        
        have h_in_t3 : h ∈ h3 :: t3 := mem_of_mem_zip_fst (h3 :: t3) t3 h h2 h_rest
        have : h ∈ h2' :: h3 :: t3 := List.mem_cons_of_mem h2' h_in_t3
        contradiction

name: nodup_zip_tail
statement:
lemma nodup_zip_tail [DecidableEq S] (path : List S) (h_nodup : path.Nodup) :
    (path.zip path.tail).Nodup
proof:
:= by
  induction path with
  | nil => simp
  | cons h t ih =>
    cases t with
    | nil => simp
    | cons h2 t2 =>
      rw [List.tail_cons]
      simp only [List.zip_cons_cons, List.nodup_cons]
      have ⟨h_not_in, h_nodup_tail⟩ := List.nodup_cons.mp h_nodup
      constructor
      · exact head_pair_not_in_tail_zip h (h2 :: t2) h_not_in h2
      · exact ih h_nodup_tail

name: nodup_transition_count_le_one
statement:
lemma nodup_transition_count_le_one (path : List S) (h_nodup : path.Nodup)
    (t : Transition S) :
    countTransitionInPath t path ≤ 1
proof:
:= by
  unfold countTransitionInPath
  have h_zip_nodup := nodup_zip_tail path h_nodup
  
  by_cases h_in : t ∈ path.zip path.tail
  · have : List.count t (path.zip path.tail) = 1 := List.count_eq_one_of_mem h_zip_nodup h_in
    omega
  · have : List.count t (path.zip path.tail) = 0 := List.count_eq_zero.mpr h_in
    omega

name: countAsFirst_cons
statement:
lemma countAsFirst_cons (hd : S) (tl : List S) (x : S) :
    countAsFirst (hd :: tl) x = (if hd = x ∧ tl ≠ [] then 1 else 0) + countAsFirst tl x
proof:
:= by
  unfold countAsFirst
  cases tl with
  | nil =>
    
    simp [List.zip, List.tail, List.countP]
  | cons hd2 tl2 =>
    
    simp only [List.zip, List.tail, List.zipWith_cons_cons, ne_eq, reduceCtorEq, not_false_eq_true,
      and_true]
    rw [List.countP_cons]
    simp
    by_cases h : hd = x <;> simp only [h, ↓reduceIte, add_zero, zero_add]
    omega

name: countAsSecond_cons
statement:
lemma countAsSecond_cons (hd : S) (tl : List S) (x : S) :
    countAsSecond (hd :: tl) x = (if tl.head? = some x then 1 else 0) + countAsSecond tl x
proof:
:= by
  unfold countAsSecond
  cases tl with
  | nil => aesop
  | cons hd2 tl2 =>
    
    simp only [List.zip, List.tail, List.zipWith_cons_cons, List.head?, Option.some.injEq]
    rw [List.countP_cons]
    simp only [decide_eq_true_eq]
    by_cases h : hd2 = x <;> simp only [h, ↓reduceIte, add_zero, zero_add]
    omega

name: countAsFirst_add_last_eq_countAsSecond_add_head
statement:
lemma countAsFirst_add_last_eq_countAsSecond_add_head (xs : List S) (x : S) :
    countAsFirst xs x + (if xs.getLast? = some x then 1 else 0) =
    countAsSecond xs x + (if xs.head? = some x then 1 else 0)
proof:
:= by
  
  induction xs with
  | nil => aesop
  | cons hd tl ih =>
    
    rw [countAsFirst_cons, countAsSecond_cons]

    cases tl with
    | nil =>
      
      unfold countAsFirst countAsSecond at ih ⊢
      simp
    | cons hd2 tl2 =>
      
      simp only [List.getLast?, Option.some.injEq, List.head?, ne_eq, reduceCtorEq,
        not_false_eq_true, and_true,
        List.getLast_cons] at ih ⊢
      omega

name: cycle_balanced_at_node
statement:
lemma cycle_balanced_at_node (cycle : List S) (x : S)
    (h_cycle : cycle.head? = cycle.getLast?) :
    (cycle.zip cycle.tail).countP (fun p => p.1 = x) =
    (cycle.zip cycle.tail).countP (fun p => p.2 = x)
proof:
:= by
  
  have h := countAsFirst_add_last_eq_countAsSecond_add_head cycle x
  unfold countAsFirst countAsSecond at h
  
  
  aesop

name: sum_count_pairs_fst
statement:
lemma sum_count_pairs_fst (xs : List (S × S)) (a : S) :
    ∑ b : S, List.count (a, b) xs = List.countP (fun p => p.1 = a) xs
proof:
:= by
  
  induction xs with
  | nil => simp
  | cons p ps ih =>
    rw [List.countP_cons]
    simp only [List.count_cons]
    
    rw [Finset.sum_add_distrib]
    rw [ih]
    congr 1
    
    cases p with | mk x y =>
    simp only
    by_cases h : x = a <;> aesop

name: sum_count_pairs_snd
statement:
lemma sum_count_pairs_snd (xs : List (S × S)) (b : S) :
    ∑ a : S, List.count (a, b) xs = List.countP (fun p => p.2 = b) xs
proof:
:= by
  
  induction xs with
  | nil => simp
  | cons p ps ih =>
    rw [List.countP_cons]
    simp only [List.count_cons]
    rw [Finset.sum_add_distrib]
    rw [ih]
    congr 1
    cases p with | mk x y =>
    simp only
    by_cases h : y = b
    · aesop
    · aesop

name: sum_countTransitionInPath_fst
statement:
lemma sum_countTransitionInPath_fst (cycle : List S) (x : S) :
    ∑ y : S, (countTransitionInPath (x, y) cycle : ℤ) = (countAsFirst cycle x : ℤ)
proof:
:= by
  unfold countAsFirst countTransitionInPath Transition
  
  
  rw [← Nat.cast_sum]
  
  
  
  have h := sum_count_pairs_fst (cycle.zip cycle.tail) x
  convert congr_arg Nat.cast h

name: sum_countTransitionInPath_snd
statement:
lemma sum_countTransitionInPath_snd (cycle : List S) (x : S) :
    ∑ y : S, (countTransitionInPath (y, x) cycle : ℤ) = (countAsSecond cycle x : ℤ)
proof:
:= by
  unfold countAsSecond countTransitionInPath Transition
  
  
  rw [← Nat.cast_sum]
  
  
  
  have h := sum_count_pairs_snd (cycle.zip cycle.tail) x
  convert congr_arg Nat.cast h

name: netFlow_sub
statement:
lemma netFlow_sub (R R' : Run S) (x : S)
    (h_valid : ∀ t, R' t ≤ R t) :
    Run.netFlow (fun t => R t - R' t) x = R.netFlow x - R'.netFlow x
proof:
:= by
  unfold Run.netFlow
  
  

  
  have h_out : ∑ y : S, (↑(R (x, y) - R' (x, y)) : ℤ) =
               ∑ y : S, (↑(R (x, y)) : ℤ) - ∑ y : S, (↑(R' (x, y)) : ℤ) := by aesop

  have h_in : ∑ y : S, (↑(R (y, x) - R' (y, x)) : ℤ) =
              ∑ y : S, (↑(R (y, x)) : ℤ) - ∑ y : S, (↑(R' (y, x)) : ℤ) := by aesop
  rw [h_out, h_in]
  omega

name: cycle_netFlow_zero
statement:
lemma cycle_netFlow_zero (cycle : List S) (x : S)
    (h_cycle : cycle.head? = cycle.getLast?) :
    Run.netFlow (fun t => countTransitionInPath t cycle) x = 0
proof:
:= by
  unfold Run.netFlow
  
  

  
  rw [sum_countTransitionInPath_fst, sum_countTransitionInPath_snd]

  
  have h_balance := cycle_balanced_at_node cycle x h_cycle

  
  unfold countAsFirst countAsSecond
  aesop

name: netFlow_removeCycle_eq
statement:
lemma netFlow_removeCycle_eq (R : Run S) (cycle : List S) (x : S)
    (h_contains : R.containsPath cycle)
    (h_cycle : cycle.head? = cycle.getLast?) :
    (R.removeCycle cycle).netFlow x = R.netFlow x
proof:
:= by

  
  have h_eq : (R.removeCycle cycle).netFlow x = Run.netFlow (fun t => R t - countTransitionInPath t cycle) x := by aesop

  rw [h_eq, netFlow_sub R (fun t => countTransitionInPath t cycle) x h_contains]
  rw [cycle_netFlow_zero cycle x h_cycle]
  simp

name: size_removeCycle_lt
statement:
lemma size_removeCycle_lt (R : Run S) (cycle : List S)
    (h_len : cycle.length ≥ 2)
    (h_contains : R.containsPath cycle)
    (_h_cycle : cycle.head? = cycle.getLast?) :
    (R.removeCycle cycle).size < R.size
proof:
:= by
  
  obtain ⟨t, h_in_zip⟩ := path_has_transition cycle h_len
  
  have h_pos := containsPath_has_positive_transition R cycle h_contains t h_in_zip
  let (x, y) := t
  
  have h_count_pos : countTransitionInPath (x, y) cycle > 0 := by
    unfold countTransitionInPath
    exact List.count_pos_iff.mpr h_in_zip
  
  
  unfold Run.size Run.removeCycle
  
  have h_decrease : (fun t => R t - countTransitionInPath t cycle) (x, y) < R (x, y) := by
    
    
    exact Nat.sub_lt h_pos h_count_pos
  have h_others_le : ∀ t, (fun t => R t - countTransitionInPath t cycle) t ≤ R t := fun t =>
    Nat.sub_le (R t) (countTransitionInPath t cycle)
  
  exact sum_decrease R (fun t => R t - countTransitionInPath t cycle) (x, y) h_decrease h_others_le

name: removeCycle_le
statement:
lemma removeCycle_le (R : Run S) (cycle : List S) (t : Transition S) :
    (R.removeCycle cycle) t ≤ R t
proof:
:= by
  unfold Run.removeCycle
  aesop

name: exists_smaller_run_with_same_netFlow
statement:
lemma exists_smaller_run_with_same_netFlow (R : Run S) (h_cycle : R.hasCycle) :
    ∃ (R' : Run S), (∀ x, R'.netFlow x = R.netFlow x) ∧ R'.size < R.size ∧ (∀ t, R' t ≤ R t)
proof:
:= by
  
  obtain ⟨cycle, h_len, h_cycle_prop, h_contains⟩ := h_cycle
  
  use R.removeCycle cycle
  constructor
  · 
    intro x
    apply netFlow_removeCycle_eq <;> aesop
  constructor
  · 
    apply size_removeCycle_lt <;> aesop
  · 
    intro t
    exact removeCycle_le R cycle t

name: acyclic_no_self_loop
statement: lemma acyclic_no_self_loop (R : Run S) (s : S) (h_acyclic : R.isAcyclic) (h_edge : R (s, s) > 0) : False
proof:
:= by
  unfold Run.isAcyclic Run.hasCycle at h_acyclic
  push Not at h_acyclic
  apply h_acyclic [s, s]
  · simp
  · simp
  · intro t
    unfold countTransitionInPath
    simp only [List.zip, List.tail, List.zipWith_cons_cons, List.zipWith_nil_right]
    by_cases h_t : t = (s, s)
    · subst h_t
      simp
      omega
    · simp [List.count_nil, Ne.symm h_t]

name: two_cycle_contains_both_edges
statement:
lemma two_cycle_contains_both_edges (R : Run S) (a b : S)
    (h_ne : a ≠ b)
    (h_edge1 : R (a, b) > 0) (h_edge2 : R (b, a) > 0) :
    ∀ t : Transition S, countTransitionInPath t [a, b, a] ≤ R t
proof:
:= by
  intro t
  unfold countTransitionInPath
  simp only [List.zip, List.tail, List.zipWith_cons_cons, List.zipWith_nil_right]
  by_cases h1 : t = (a, b)
  · subst h1
    have hne : ¬((b, a) = (a, b)) := fun h_eq => h_ne (Prod.mk_inj.mp h_eq).1.symm
    simp [hne]
    omega
  · by_cases h2 : t = (b, a)
    · subst h2
      have hne : ¬((a, b) = (b, a)) := fun h_eq => h_ne (Prod.mk_inj.mp h_eq).1
      simp [hne]
      omega
    · simp [Ne.symm h1, Ne.symm h2]

name: acyclic_no_two_cycle
statement:
lemma acyclic_no_two_cycle (R : Run S) (a b : S)
    (h_acyclic : R.isAcyclic) (h_ne : a ≠ b)
    (h_edge1 : R (a, b) > 0) (h_edge2 : R (b, a) > 0) : False
proof:
:= by
  unfold Run.isAcyclic Run.hasCycle at h_acyclic
  push Not at h_acyclic
  apply h_acyclic [a, b, a]
  · simp
  · simp
  · exact two_cycle_contains_both_edges R a b h_ne h_edge1 h_edge2

name: getLast_mem
statement:
lemma getLast_mem {α : Type*} (l : List α) (x : α) (h_last : l.getLast? = some x) :
    x ∈ l
proof:
:= by
  have h_ne : l ≠ [] := by
    intro h_eq
    simp [h_eq] at h_last
  rw [List.getLast?_eq_some_getLast h_ne] at h_last
  cases h_last
  exact List.getLast_mem h_ne

name: last_not_in_zip_tail
statement:
lemma last_not_in_zip_tail {α : Type*} [DecidableEq α] (l : List α) (x : α)
    (h_nodup : l.Nodup)
    (h_last : l.getLast? = some x) :
    ∀ y : α, (x, y) ∉ l.zip l.tail
proof:
:= by
  intro y h_in
  
  
  
  induction l with
  | nil =>
    simp at h_last
  | cons head tail ih =>
    cases tail with
    | nil =>
      simp at h_in
    | cons head2 tail2 =>
      simp only [List.getLast?_cons_cons] at h_last
      simp only [List.tail_cons, List.zip_cons_cons, List.mem_cons, Prod.mk.injEq] at h_in
      
      have h_nodup_tail := List.nodup_cons.mp h_nodup
      cases h_in with
      | inl h_eq =>
        
        have h_x_head : x = head := h_eq.1
        subst h_x_head
        
        
        have h_x_in_tail := getLast_mem (head2 :: tail2) x h_last
        grind
      | inr h_in_rest => grind

name: drop_of_lt_length_nonempty
statement:
lemma drop_of_lt_length_nonempty {α : Type*} (path : List α) (i : ℕ)
    (h_i_lt : i < path.length) :
    path.drop i ≠ []
proof:
:= by
  intro h_empty
  have : (path.drop i).length = 0 := by simp [h_empty]
  rw [List.length_drop] at this
  omega

name: cycle_from_suffix_contains
statement:
lemma cycle_from_suffix_contains (R : Run S) (suffix : List S) (current y : S)
    (h_suffix_nodup : suffix.Nodup)
    (h_contains_suffix : R.containsPath suffix)
    (h_suffix_nonempty : suffix ≠ [])
    (h_suffix_last : suffix.getLast? = some current)
    (h_edge : R (current, y) > 0) :
    ∀ t : Transition S, countTransitionInPath t (suffix ++ [y]) ≤ R t
proof:
:= by
  intro t
  by_cases h_t_eq : t = (current, y)
  · subst h_t_eq
    have h_not_in : (current, y) ∉ suffix.zip suffix.tail :=
      last_not_in_zip_tail suffix current h_suffix_nodup h_suffix_last y
    have h_count_one := countTransitionInPath_append_singleton suffix current y h_suffix_nonempty h_suffix_last h_not_in
    unfold countTransitionInPath at h_count_one ⊢
    omega
  · have h_count_same := countTransitionInPath_append_singleton_other suffix current y t h_suffix_nonempty h_suffix_last h_t_eq
    unfold countTransitionInPath at h_count_same ⊢
    rw [h_count_same]
    exact h_contains_suffix t

name: path_with_back_edge_creates_cycle
statement:
lemma path_with_back_edge_creates_cycle (R : Run S) (path : List S) (current y : S)
    (h_acyclic : R.isAcyclic)
    (h_end : path.getLast? = some current)
    (h_contains : R.containsPath path)
    (h_y_in_path : y ∈ path)
    (h_edge : R (current, y) > 0) :
    R.hasCycle
proof:
:= by
  
  rw [List.mem_iff_getElem] at h_y_in_path
  obtain ⟨i, h_i_lt, h_y_eq⟩ := h_y_in_path
  let suffix := path.drop i
  have h_suffix_nonempty : suffix ≠ [] := drop_of_lt_length_nonempty path i h_i_lt
  have h_suffix_head : suffix.head? = some y := by aesop
  have h_suffix_last : suffix.getLast? = some current := by grind
  let cycle := suffix ++ [y]
  have h_cycle_head : cycle.head? = some y := by grind
  have h_cycle_last : cycle.getLast? = some y := by grind
  have h_cycle_len : cycle.length ≥ 2 := by grind
  use cycle
  constructor
  · exact h_cycle_len
  constructor
  · rw [h_cycle_head, h_cycle_last]
  · unfold cycle
    have h_suffix_contains : R.containsPath suffix := by
      unfold suffix
      exact containsPath_drop R path i h_contains
    have h_path_nodup := acyclic_containsPath_nodup R path h_acyclic h_contains
    have h_suffix_nodup : suffix.Nodup := by grind
    exact cycle_from_suffix_contains R suffix current y h_suffix_nodup h_suffix_contains h_suffix_nonempty h_suffix_last h_edge

name: acyclic_edge_not_in_path
statement:
lemma acyclic_edge_not_in_path (R : Run S) (path : List S) (current y : S)
    (h_acyclic : R.isAcyclic)
    (h_end : path.getLast? = some current)
    (h_contains : R.containsPath path)
    (h_edge : R (current, y) > 0)
    (h_y_in_path : y ∈ path) :
    False
proof:
:= by
  
  have h_hasCycle : R.hasCycle :=
    path_with_back_edge_creates_cycle R path current y h_acyclic h_end h_contains h_y_in_path h_edge
  aesop

name: not_mem_implies_transition_not_in_zip_tail
statement:
lemma not_mem_implies_transition_not_in_zip_tail {α : Type*} (path : List α) (x y : α)
    (h_y_not_in : y ∉ path) :
    (x, y) ∉ path.zip path.tail
proof:
:= by
  intro h_in
  have h_y_in_tail : y ∈ path.tail := (List.of_mem_zip h_in).2
  have h_y_in_path : y ∈ path := List.mem_of_mem_tail h_y_in_tail
  exact h_y_not_in h_y_in_path

name: containsPath_append_singleton
statement:
lemma containsPath_append_singleton (R : Run S) (path : List S) (x y : S)
    (h_nonempty : path ≠ [])
    (h_last : path.getLast? = some x)
    (h_contains : R.containsPath path)
    (h_y_not_in_path : y ∉ path)
    (h_edge : R (x, y) > 0) :
    R.containsPath (path ++ [y])
proof:
:= by
  intro t
  have h_current_y_not_in_path := not_mem_implies_transition_not_in_zip_tail path x y h_y_not_in_path
  by_cases h_t_eq : t = (x, y)
  · subst h_t_eq
    have h_new_count : countTransitionInPath (x, y) (path ++ [y]) = 1 :=
      countTransitionInPath_append_singleton path x y h_nonempty h_last h_current_y_not_in_path
    unfold countTransitionInPath at h_new_count ⊢
    aesop
  · have h_count_same : countTransitionInPath t (path ++ [y]) = countTransitionInPath t path :=
      countTransitionInPath_append_singleton_other path x y t h_nonempty h_last h_t_eq
    unfold countTransitionInPath at h_count_same ⊢
    aesop

name: acyclic_has_leaf_aux
statement:
lemma acyclic_has_leaf_aux (R : Run S) (root current : S)
    (path : List S)
    (h_acyclic : R.isAcyclic)
    (h_start : path.head? = some root)
    (h_end : path.getLast? = some current)
    (h_nonempty : path ≠ [])
    (h_contains : R.containsPath path)
    (h_has_out : ∃ y, y ∉ path ∧ R (current, y) > 0) :
    ∃ leaf, R.isLeaf root leaf
proof:
:= by
  
  obtain ⟨y, h_y_not_in_path, h_edge⟩ := h_has_out

  
  by_cases h_y_has_out : ∃ z, z ∉ path ∧ z ≠ y ∧ R (y, z) > 0
  case neg =>
    
    
    use y
    constructor
    · 
      
      use path ++ [y]
      constructor
      · aesop
      constructor
      · simp
      constructor
      · aesop
      · exact containsPath_append_singleton R path current y h_nonempty h_end h_contains h_y_not_in_path h_edge
    · 
      intro z
      by_contra h_pos
      push Not at h_y_has_out
      
      have h_z_pos : R (y, z) > 0 := by omega
      have h_z_in_path_or_y : z ∈ path ∨ z = y := by grind

      
      cases h_z_in_path_or_y with
      | inl h_z_in_path =>
        
        
        
        have h_z_in_extended : z ∈ path ++ [y] := by aesop
        exact acyclic_edge_not_in_path R (path ++ [y]) y z h_acyclic (by simp) (containsPath_append_singleton R path current y h_nonempty h_end h_contains h_y_not_in_path h_edge) h_z_pos h_z_in_extended
      | inr h_z_eq_y =>
        
        rw [h_z_eq_y] at h_z_pos
        exact acyclic_no_self_loop R y h_acyclic h_z_pos

  case pos =>
    
    
    obtain ⟨z, h_z_not_in_path, h_z_ne_y, h_y_z_edge⟩ := h_y_has_out

    
    let new_path := path ++ [y]

    
    have h_new_start : new_path.head? = some root := by aesop
    have h_new_end : new_path.getLast? = some y := by aesop
    have h_new_nonempty : new_path ≠ [] := by aesop
    have h_new_contains : R.containsPath new_path :=
      containsPath_append_singleton R path current y h_nonempty h_end h_contains h_y_not_in_path h_edge

    have h_new_has_out : ∃ w, w ∉ new_path ∧ R (y, w) > 0 := by grind
    exact acyclic_has_leaf_aux R root y new_path h_acyclic h_new_start h_new_end h_new_nonempty h_new_contains h_new_has_out

name: acyclic_has_leaf
statement:
lemma acyclic_has_leaf (R : Run S) (root : S)
    (h_acyclic : R.isAcyclic)
    (h_has_out : ∃ y, R (root, y) > 0) :
    ∃ leaf, R.isLeaf root leaf
proof:
:= by
  
  have h_root_start : [root].head? = some root := by simp
  have h_root_end : [root].getLast? = some root := by simp
  have h_root_nonempty : [root] ≠ [] := by simp
  have h_root_contains : R.containsPath [root] := by
    intro t
    simp [countTransitionInPath, List.count_nil]

  
  obtain ⟨y, h_pos⟩ := h_has_out
  apply acyclic_has_leaf_aux R root root [root] h_acyclic h_root_start h_root_end h_root_nonempty h_root_contains
  use y
  constructor
  · intro h_mem
    simp at h_mem
    rw [h_mem] at h_pos
    exact acyclic_no_self_loop R root h_acyclic h_pos
  · exact h_pos

name: single_le_sum_of_nonneg
statement:
lemma single_le_sum_of_nonneg {α : Type*} [Fintype α] (f : α → ℤ) (a : α)
    (h_nonneg : ∀ x, f x ≥ 0) :
    f a ≤ ∑ x : α, f x
proof:
:= by
  calc f a
    = ∑ x ∈ ({a} : Finset α), f x := by simp
  _ ≤ ∑ x : α, f x := by
      apply Finset.sum_le_univ_sum_of_nonneg
      intro x
      exact h_nonneg x

name: sum_pos_of_pos_element
statement:
lemma sum_pos_of_pos_element {α : Type*} [Fintype α] (f : α → ℤ) (a : α)
    (h_pos : f a > 0)
    (h_nonneg : ∀ x, f x ≥ 0) :
    ∑ x : α, f x > 0
proof:
:= by
  have h_a_in_sum : f a ≤ ∑ x : α, f x := single_le_sum_of_nonneg f a h_nonneg
  omega

name: sum_nat_cast_pos
statement:
lemma sum_nat_cast_pos {α : Type*} [Fintype α] (f : α → ℕ) (a : α)
    (h_pos : f a > 0) :
    ∑ x : α, (f x : ℤ) > 0
proof:
:= by
  apply sum_pos_of_pos_element (fun z => (f z : ℤ)) a
  · omega
  · intro x
    omega

name: leaf_has_negative_netFlow
statement:
lemma leaf_has_negative_netFlow (R : Run S) (root leaf : S)
    (h_leaf : R.isLeaf root leaf)
    (h_in : ∃ y, R (y, leaf) > 0) :
    R.netFlow leaf < 0
proof:
:= by
  
  obtain ⟨_, h_no_out⟩ := h_leaf
  obtain ⟨y, hy⟩ := h_in
  
  unfold Run.netFlow
  
  have h_outflow_zero : ∑ y : S, (R (leaf, y) : ℤ) = 0 := by
    simp only [h_no_out]
    simp
  
  have h_inflow_pos : ∑ z : S, (R (z, leaf) : ℤ) > 0 :=
    sum_nat_cast_pos (fun z => R (z, leaf)) y hy
  
  rw [h_outflow_zero]
  omega

name: sum_zero_of_all_zero
statement:
lemma sum_zero_of_all_zero {α : Type*} [Fintype α] (f : α → ℕ) (h : ∀ x, f x = 0) :
    ∑ x : α, (f x : ℤ) = 0
proof:
:= by
  simp [h]

name: sum_nat_cast_nonneg
statement:
lemma sum_nat_cast_nonneg {α : Type*} [Fintype α] (f : α → ℕ) :
    0 ≤ ∑ x : α, (f x : ℤ)
proof:
:= by
  apply Finset.sum_nonneg
  intro x _
  omega

name: sum_nat_cast_zero_of_not_pos
statement:
lemma sum_nat_cast_zero_of_not_pos {α : Type*} [Fintype α] (f : α → ℕ)
    (h : ∀ x, ¬(f x > 0)) :
    ∑ x : α, (f x : ℤ) = 0
proof:
:= by
  apply sum_zero_of_all_zero
  intro y
  have h_le := h y
  omega

name: positive_netFlow_has_outgoing_edge
statement:
lemma positive_netFlow_has_outgoing_edge (R : Run S) (s : S)
    (h_pos : R.netFlow s > 0) :
    ∃ y, R (s, y) > 0
proof:
:= by
  
  by_contra h_none
  push Not at h_none
  
  have h_outflow_zero : ∑ y : S, (R (s, y) : ℤ) = 0 := by
    apply sum_nat_cast_zero_of_not_pos
    intro y
    have := h_none y
    omega
  
  unfold Run.netFlow at h_pos
  rw [h_outflow_zero] at h_pos
  
  have h_inflow_nonneg := sum_nat_cast_nonneg (fun y => R (y, s))
  omega

name: last_has_incoming_transition
statement:
lemma last_has_incoming_transition {α : Type*} (l : List α) (x : α)
    (h_len : l.length ≥ 2)
    (h_last : l.getLast? = some x) :
    ∃ y, (y, x) ∈ l.zip l.tail
proof:
:= by
  cases l with
  | nil => simp at h_len
  | cons hd tl =>
    cases tl with
    | nil => simp at h_len
    | cons hd2 tl2 =>
      
      
      simp only [List.getLast?_cons_cons] at h_last
      
      cases tl2 with
      | nil => aesop
      | cons hd3 tl3 =>
        have h_tail_len : (hd2 :: hd3 :: tl3).length ≥ 2 := by grind
        obtain ⟨y, h_y_in⟩ := last_has_incoming_transition (hd2 :: hd3 :: tl3) x h_tail_len h_last
        aesop

name: path_distinct_head_last_length_ge_two
statement:
lemma path_distinct_head_last_length_ge_two {α : Type*} (path : List α) (x y : α)
    (h_nonempty : path ≠ [])
    (h_head : path.head? = some x)
    (h_last : path.getLast? = some y)
    (h_ne : x ≠ y) :
    path.length ≥ 2
proof:
:= by
  by_contra h_not
  push Not at h_not
  cases path with
  | nil => simp at h_nonempty
  | cons hd tl =>
    cases tl with
    | nil =>
      
      simp only [List.head?, Option.some.injEq, List.getLast?,
        List.getLast_singleton] at h_head h_last
      have : x = y := by rw [← h_head, ← h_last]
      exact h_ne this
    | cons hd2 tl2 =>
      
      simp only [List.length] at h_not
      omega

name: reachable_leaf_has_incoming_edge
statement:
lemma reachable_leaf_has_incoming_edge (R : Run S) (root leaf : S)
    (h_leaf : R.isLeaf root leaf)
    (h_ne : root ≠ leaf) :
    ∃ y, R (y, leaf) > 0
proof:
:= by
  
  obtain ⟨h_reach, _⟩ := h_leaf
  
  obtain ⟨path, h_head, h_last, h_nonempty, h_contains⟩ := h_reach
  
  have h_len := path_distinct_head_last_length_ge_two path root leaf h_nonempty h_head h_last h_ne
  
  obtain ⟨y, h_y_leaf_in⟩ := last_has_incoming_transition path leaf h_len h_last
  
  use y
  exact containsPath_has_positive_transition R path h_contains (y, leaf) h_y_leaf_in

name: unique_negative_netFlow
statement:
lemma unique_negative_netFlow (R : Run S) (s d x : S)
    (h_source : R.netFlow s = 1)
    (h_others : ∀ y, y ≠ s → y ≠ d → R.netFlow y = 0)
    (h_x_neg : R.netFlow x < 0) :
    x = d
proof:
:= by
  by_contra h_ne
  have h_not_s : x ≠ s := by
    intro h_eq
    rw [h_eq] at h_x_neg
    rw [h_source] at h_x_neg
    omega
  have h_x_zero := h_others x h_not_s h_ne
  omega

name: leaf_has_incoming_and_negative_netFlow
statement:
lemma leaf_has_incoming_and_negative_netFlow (R : Run S) (root leaf : S)
    (h_leaf : R.isLeaf root leaf)
    (h_root_out : ∃ y, R (root, y) > 0) :
    R.netFlow leaf < 0
proof:
:= by
  apply leaf_has_negative_netFlow R root leaf h_leaf
  
  
  by_cases h_eq : root = leaf
  · 
    subst h_eq
    obtain ⟨_, h_no_out⟩ := h_leaf
    obtain ⟨y, h_pos⟩ := h_root_out
    have := h_no_out y
    omega
  · 
    exact reachable_leaf_has_incoming_edge R root leaf h_leaf h_eq

name: acyclic_run_has_path_from_source_to_sink
statement:
lemma acyclic_run_has_path_from_source_to_sink (R : Run S) (s d : S)
    (h_acyclic : R.isAcyclic)
    (h_source : R.netFlow s = 1)
    (h_others : ∀ x, x ≠ s → x ≠ d → R.netFlow x = 0) :
    ∃ (path : List S), path.head? = some s ∧ path.getLast? = some d ∧
      path ≠ [] ∧ R.containsPath path ∧ path.Nodup
proof:
:= by
  
  have h_s_out : ∃ y, R (s, y) > 0 := by
    apply positive_netFlow_has_outgoing_edge
    rw [h_source]
    omega

  
  obtain ⟨leaf, h_leaf⟩ := acyclic_has_leaf R s h_acyclic h_s_out

  
  have h_leaf_neg := leaf_has_incoming_and_negative_netFlow R s leaf h_leaf h_s_out

  
  have h_leaf_eq_d := unique_negative_netFlow R s d leaf h_source h_others h_leaf_neg

  
  rw [h_leaf_eq_d] at h_leaf
  obtain ⟨h_reach, _⟩ := h_leaf
  obtain ⟨path, h_head, h_last, h_nonempty, h_contains⟩ := h_reach
  use path
  refine ⟨h_head, h_last, h_nonempty, h_contains, ?_⟩
  exact acyclic_containsPath_nodup R path h_acyclic h_contains

name: exists_path_from_source_to_sink
statement:
theorem exists_path_from_source_to_sink
    (R : Run S) (s d : S)
    (h_source : R.netFlow s = 1)
    (h_others : ∀ x, x ≠ s → x ≠ d → R.netFlow x = 0) :
    ∃ (path : List S), path.head? = some s ∧ path.getLast? = some d ∧
      path ≠ [] ∧ R.containsPath path ∧ path.Nodup
proof:
:= by
  
  by_cases h_cyclic : R.hasCycle
  case pos =>
    
    obtain ⟨R', h_netFlow_preserved, h_size_lt, h_R'_le_R⟩ := exists_smaller_run_with_same_netFlow R h_cyclic
    
    have h_source' : R'.netFlow s = 1 := by aesop
    have h_others' : ∀ x, x ≠ s → x ≠ d → R'.netFlow x = 0 := by aesop
    
    obtain ⟨path, h_head, h_last, h_nonempty, h_contains', h_nodup⟩ :=
      exists_path_from_source_to_sink R' s d h_source' h_others'
    use path
    refine ⟨h_head, h_last, h_nonempty, ?_, h_nodup⟩
    
    
    intro t
    calc countTransitionInPath t path
      ≤ R' t := h_contains' t
    _ ≤ R t := h_R'_le_R t
  case neg =>
    
    exact acyclic_run_has_path_from_source_to_sink R s d h_cyclic h_source h_others

name: fromNat_val
statement: theorem fromNat_val (x : F) : fromNat (val x) = x
proof:
:=
  val_injective (val_fromNat _ (val_lt x))

name: fieldSize_pos
statement: theorem fieldSize_pos : FiniteField.size F > 1
proof:
:= by
  have := val_lt (1 : F); rwa [val_one] at this

name: fromNat_zero
statement: @[simp, circuit_norm] theorem fromNat_zero : (fromNat 0 : F) = 0
proof:
:=
  val_injective (by rw [val_fromNat 0 (by have := fieldSize_pos (F := F); omega), val_zero])

name: fromNat_one
statement: @[simp, circuit_norm] theorem fromNat_one : (fromNat 1 : F) = 1
proof:
:=
  val_injective (by rw [val_fromNat 1 fieldSize_pos, val_one])

name: ext
statement: theorem ext {x y : F} (h : val x = val y) : x = y
proof:
:=
  val_injective h

name: ext_iff
statement: theorem ext_iff {x y : F} : x = y ↔ val x = val y
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun h => h ▸ rfl, ext⟩

name: val_inj
statement:
@[circuit_norm]
theorem val_inj {x y : F} : val x = val y ↔ x = y
proof: := ext_iff.symm

name: FiniteField.fromNat_F
statement:
@[simp, circuit_norm] theorem FiniteField.fromNat_F {p : ℕ} [Fact p.Prime] (n : ℕ) :
    (FiniteField.fromNat n : F p) = (n : F p)
proof: := rfl

name: FiniteField.val_F
statement:
@[simp, circuit_norm] theorem FiniteField.val_F {p : ℕ} [Fact p.Prime] (x : F p) :
    FiniteField.val x = ZMod.val x
proof: := rfl

name: FiniteField.val_inj_F
statement:
theorem FiniteField.val_inj_F {p : ℕ} [Fact p.Prime] (x y : F p) :
    ZMod.val x = ZMod.val y ↔ x = y
proof:
:= by
  rw [← FiniteField.val_F, ← FiniteField.val_F]
  exact FiniteField.val_inj

name: toList_length_one
statement:
theorem toList_length_one {α : Type} (v : Vector α 1) :
    v.toList = [v[0]]
proof:
:= by
  
  cases v using Vector.casesOn with
  | mk arr h =>
      cases arr using Array.casesOn with
      | mk lst =>
        
        
        simp only [List.size_toArray] at h
        
        match lst with
        | [] => simp at h
        | [x] =>
          
          
          
          rfl
        | _ :: _ :: _ => simp [List.length] at h

name: toList_length_two
statement:
theorem toList_length_two {α : Type} (v : Vector α 2) :
    v.toList = [v[0], v[1]]
proof:
:= by
  
  cases v using Vector.casesOn with
  | mk arr h =>
      cases arr using Array.casesOn with
      | mk lst =>
        simp only [List.size_toArray] at h
        match lst with
        | [] => simp at h
        | [_] => simp [List.length] at h
        | [x, y] => rfl
        | _ :: _ :: _ :: _ => simp [List.length] at h

name: toList_listCons
statement: @[simp] theorem toList_listCons {a : α} {v : Vector α n} : (listCons a v).toList = a :: v.toList
proof:

name: getElem_listCons_zero
statement:
@[simp] theorem getElem_listCons_zero {a : α} {v : Vector α n} :

name: getElem_listCons_succ

@[simp] theorem getElem_listCons_succ {a : α} {v : Vector α n} (i : ℕ) (hi : i < n) :
    (listCons a v)[i + 1] = v[i]
proof:

name: cast_heq
statement: theorem cast_heq {v : Vector α n} (h : n = m) : HEq (v.cast h) v
proof:

  subst h

name: heq_cast
statement: theorem heq_cast {v : Vector α n} (h : n = m) : HEq v (v.cast h)

name: cast_eq_iff_eq_cast

lemma cast_eq_iff_eq_cast {v : Vector α n} {w : Vector α m} (h : n = m) :

proof:

name: eq_cast_iff_cast_eq
statement:
lemma eq_cast_iff_cast_eq {v : Vector α m} {w : Vector α n} (h : n = m) :

name: empty_push
statement: theorem empty_push (x : α) : #v[].push x = #v[x]
proof: := by rfl

name: listCons_push
statement:
theorem listCons_push (x y : α) (xs : Vector α n) :
    (listCons x xs).push y = listCons x (xs.push y)
proof: := by rfl

name: inductPush_nil
proof: := by simp only [inductPush]; rfl

name: inductPush_listCons_push
proof:
:= by
  conv => lhs; simp only [listCons, inductPush]
  apply (cast_eq_iff_heq).mpr
  have h_push_len : (xs.push a).toList.length = n + 1 := by simp
  have h_to_push_cons :
      HEq (toPush ⟨.mk (x :: (xs.push a).toList), rfl⟩).1 (listCons x xs) := by
    have : (toPush ⟨.mk (x :: (xs.push a).toList), rfl⟩).1 =
        (listCons x xs).cast h_push_len.symm := by
      simp [listCons, toPush, toList_push, List.dropLast]
    rw [this]; apply cast_heq
  congr
  · have : (toPush ⟨.mk (x :: (xs.push a).toList), rfl⟩).2.1 = a := by
      simp [toPush, toList_push]
    rw [this]

name: inductPush_push
proof:
:= by
  induction as using Vector.induct
  case nil =>
    suffices inductPush nil push #v[a] = push #v[] a (inductPush nil push #v[]) by congr
    simp only [inductPush, List.length_nil, Nat.reduceAdd, toPush, cast_eq]
    congr
    exact inductPush_nil
  case cons x xs ih =>
    simp only [← inductPush_listCons_push]
    congr

name: getElemFin_finRange
statement: theorem getElemFin_finRange {n} (i : Fin n) : (finRange n)[i] = i
proof:

name: mapFinRange_zero
statement: theorem mapFinRange_zero {create : Fin 0 → α} : mapFinRange 0 create = #v[]

name: mapFinRange_succ
statement:
theorem mapFinRange_succ {n : ℕ} {create : Fin (n + 1) → α} :
    mapFinRange (n + 1) create = (mapFinRange n (fun i => create i.castSucc)).push (create (.last n))
proof:
:= by
  rw [mapFinRange, mapFinRange, finRange_succ_last]
  simp only [append_singleton, map_push, map_map]

name: cast_mapFinRange
statement:
theorem cast_mapFinRange {n} {create : Fin n → α} (h : n = m) :
    mapFinRange n create = (mapFinRange m (fun i => create (i.cast h.symm))).cast h.symm

name: getElemFin_mapFinRange
statement:
theorem getElemFin_mapFinRange {n} {create : Fin n → α} :

name: getElem_mapFinRange
statement:
theorem getElem_mapFinRange {n} {create : Fin n → α} :
    ∀ (i : ℕ) (hi : i < n), (mapFinRange n create)[i] = create ⟨ i, hi ⟩

name: mapFinRange_eq_map
statement:
lemma mapFinRange_eq_map {n : ℕ} (v : Vector α n) (f : α → β) :

name: mapFinRange_eq_self

lemma mapFinRange_eq_self {α : Type} {n : ℕ} (v : Vector α n) :

name: map_mapFinRange
statement:
lemma map_mapFinRange {n : ℕ} {create : Fin n → α} {f : α → β} :

    Vector.mapFinRange n (fun i => f (create i))

name: mapRange_zero
statement: theorem mapRange_zero {create : ℕ → α} : mapRange 0 create = #v[]
proof: := rfl

name: mapRange_succ
statement:
theorem mapRange_succ {n} {create : ℕ → α} :
    mapRange (n + 1) create = (mapRange n create).push (create n)
proof: := rfl

name: cast_mapRange
statement:
theorem cast_mapRange {n} {create : ℕ → α} (h : n = m) :
    mapRange n create = (mapRange m create).cast h.symm
proof:
:= by
  subst h; simp

name: getElem_mapRange
statement:
theorem getElem_mapRange {n} {create : ℕ → α} :
    ∀ (i : ℕ) (hi : i < n), (mapRange n create)[i] = create i
proof:
:= by
  intros i hi
  induction n
  case zero => simp at hi
  case succ n ih =>
    rw [mapRange_succ]
    by_cases hi' : i < n
    · rw [getElem_push_lt hi', ih hi']
    · have i_eq : n = i := by linarith
      subst i_eq
      rw [getElem_push_eq]

name: map_mapRange
statement:
theorem map_mapRange {n} {create : ℕ → α} {f : α → β} :
  Vector.map f (Vector.mapRange n create) =
    Vector.mapRange n (fun i => f (create i))
proof:
:= by
  rw [Vector.ext_iff]
  simp [getElem_mapRange, getElem_map]

name: mapRange_eq_mapFinRange
statement:
theorem mapRange_eq_mapFinRange {n} {create : ℕ → α} :
    Vector.mapRange n create = Vector.mapFinRange n (fun i => create i.val)
proof:

  rw [Vector.ext_iff]
  simp [getElem_mapRange, getElem_mapFinRange]

name: zip_mapRange
statement:
theorem zip_mapRange {n} {create1 : ℕ → α} (v : Vector β n) :
    Vector.zip (mapRange n create1) v =
      Vector.mapFinRange n fun i => (create1 i.val, v[i])
proof:
:= by
  rw [Vector.ext_iff]
  intro i hi
  simp only [Vector.getElem_zip, Vector.getElem_mapFinRange, Vector.getElem_mapRange]
  rfl

name: mapRange_add_eq_append
statement:
theorem mapRange_add_eq_append {n m} (create : ℕ → α) :
    mapRange (n + m) create = mapRange n create ++ mapRange m (fun i => create (n + i))
proof:
:= by
  induction m with
  | zero => simp only [Nat.add_zero, mapRange, append_empty]
  | succ m ih => simp only [mapRange, Nat.add_eq, append_push, ih]

name: getElem_fill
statement:
theorem getElem_fill {n} {a : α} {i : ℕ} {hi : i < n} :
    (fill n a)[i] = a
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero => nomatch hi
  | succ => simp_all [fill, getElem_push]

name: cast_take_append_of_eq_length
statement:
theorem cast_take_append_of_eq_length {v : Vector α n} {w : Vector α m} :
    (v ++ w |>.take n |>.cast Nat.min_add_right_self) = v
proof:
:= by
  have hv_length : v.toArray.toList.length = n := by simp
  rw [cast_mk, ←toArray_inj, take_eq_extract, toArray_extract, toArray_append,
    List.extract_toArray, Array.toList_append,
    List.extract_eq_take_drop, List.drop_zero, Nat.sub_zero,
    List.take_append_of_le_length (Nat.le_of_eq hv_length.symm),
    List.take_of_length_le (Nat.le_of_eq hv_length), Array.toArray_toList]

name: cast_drop_append_of_eq_length
statement:
theorem cast_drop_append_of_eq_length {v : Vector α n} {w : Vector α m} :
    (v ++ w |>.drop n |>.cast (Nat.add_sub_self_left n m)) = w
proof:
:= by
  have hv_length : v.toArray.toList.length = n := by simp
  have hw_length : w.toArray.toList.length = m := by simp
  rw [drop_eq_cast_extract, cast_cast, cast_mk, ←toArray_inj, toArray_extract, toArray_append,
    List.extract_toArray, Array.toList_append,
    List.extract_eq_take_drop, Nat.add_sub_self_left,
    List.drop_append_of_le_length (Nat.le_of_eq hv_length.symm),
    List.drop_of_length_le (Nat.le_of_eq hv_length), List.nil_append,
    List.take_of_length_le (Nat.le_of_eq hw_length), Array.toArray_toList]

name: append_take_drop
statement:
theorem append_take_drop {v : Vector α (n + m)} :
    (v.take n |>.cast Nat.min_add_right_self) ++ (v.drop n |>.cast (Nat.add_sub_self_left n m)) = v
proof:
:= by
  rw [take_eq_extract, drop_eq_cast_extract, cast_cast, Vector.ext_iff]
  intro i hi
  rw [getElem_append]
  by_cases hi' : i < n
  · have goal' : (v.extract 0 n)[i] = v[0 + i] := getElem_extract (by omega)
    simp_all [getElem_cast]
  simp only [hi', reduceDIte, getElem_cast, getElem_extract]
  congr
  omega

name: map_take
statement:
lemma map_take {α β : Type} {n : ℕ} (f : α → β) (xs : Vector α n) (i : ℕ) :
    (xs.map f).take i = (xs.take i).map f
proof:
:= by
  ext j hj
  simp only [Vector.getElem_map, Vector.getElem_take]

name: toChunks_push
statement:
theorem toChunks_push (m : ℕ) {α : Type} (vs : Vector α (n*m)) (v : Vector α m) :
    (vs.toChunks m).push v = ((vs ++ v).cast (by simp [add_mul])).toChunks m
proof:
:= by
  simp only [toChunks]
  nth_rw 1 [← cast_take_append_of_eq_length (v := vs) (w := v)]
  nth_rw 2 [← cast_drop_append_of_eq_length (v := vs) (w := v)]
  rfl

name: toChunks_flatten
statement:
theorem toChunks_flatten {α : Type} (m : ℕ) (v : Vector α (n*m)) :
    (v.toChunks m).flatten = v
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero => simp [toChunks]
  | succ n ih =>
    simp only [toChunks, flatten_push, ih]
    rw [Vector.ext_iff]
    intro i hi
    rw [getElem_cast, getElem_append]
    by_cases hi' : i < n * m
    · simp only [hi', ↓reduceDIte, getElem_cast, getElem_take]
    · simp only [hi', reduceDIte, getElem_cast, getElem_drop]
      grind

name: flatten_toChunks
statement:
theorem flatten_toChunks {α : Type} (m : ℕ) (v : Vector (Vector α m) n) :
    v.flatten.toChunks m = v
proof:
:= by
  induction v using Vector.inductPush with
  | nil => simp [toChunks]
  | push as a ih =>
    nth_rw 2 [← ih]
    simp only [flatten_push, toChunks_push]

name: mapM_singleton
statement:
theorem mapM_singleton (a : α) {m : Type → Type} [Monad m] [LawfulMonad m] (f : α → m β) :
    #v[a].mapM f = (do pure #v[←f a])
proof:
:= by
  apply map_toArray_inj.mp
  simp

name: mapM_push
statement:
theorem mapM_push (as : Vector α n) {m : Type → Type} [Monad m] [LawfulMonad m] (f : α → m β) (a : α) :
    (as.push a).mapM f = (do
      let bs ← as.mapM f
      let b ← f a
      pure (bs.push b))
proof:
:= by
  rw [←append_singleton, mapM_append, mapM_singleton]
  simp only [bind_pure_comp, Functor.map_map, append_singleton]

name: rotate_rotate
statement:
theorem rotate_rotate {α : Type} {n : ℕ} (v : Vector α n) (off1 off2 : ℕ) :
    v.rotate (off1 + off2) = (v.rotate off1).rotate off2
proof:
:= by
  simp only [rotate, toList_mk, List.rotate_rotate]

name: getElem_rotate
statement:
theorem getElem_rotate {α : Type} {n : ℕ} {v : Vector α n} {off : ℕ} {i : ℕ} (hi : i < n) :
    (v.rotate off)[i] = v[(i + off) % n]'(Nat.mod_lt _ (Nat.pos_iff_ne_zero.mpr (Nat.ne_zero_of_lt hi)))
proof:
:= by
  rcases v with ⟨ ⟨ xs ⟩ , h ⟩
  simp only [List.size_toArray] at h
  simp [rotate, toList_mk, List.getElem_rotate, h]

name: getElem_takeShort
statement:
lemma getElem_takeShort {α : Type} {n : ℕ} (v : Vector α n) (j : ℕ) (h_j : j < n) (i : ℕ) (h_i : i < j) :
    (v.takeShort j h_j)[i] = v[i]
proof:
:= by
  simp only [takeShort, getElem_cast, getElem_take]

name: map_takeShort
statement:
lemma map_takeShort {α β : Type} (f : α → β) {j n : ℕ} (v : Vector α n) (h_j : j < n) :
    Vector.map f (v.takeShort j h_j) = (v.map f).takeShort j h_j
proof:
:= by
  simp only [Vector.takeShort]
  ext k h_k
  simp only [Vector.getElem_map, Vector.getElem_take, Vector.getElem_cast]

name: List.foldl_and_IsBool
statement:
theorem List.foldl_and_IsBool (l : List ℕ) :
    IsBool (List.foldl (· &&& ·) 1 l : ℕ)
proof:
:= by
  
  
  suffices h_general : ∀ (init : ℕ), IsBool init → IsBool (List.foldl (· &&& ·) init l) by
    exact h_general 1 IsBool.one

  intro init h_init
  induction l generalizing init with
  | nil =>
    simp only [List.foldl_nil]
    exact h_init
  | cons x xs ih =>
    simp only [List.foldl_cons]
    apply ih
    apply IsBool.land_inherit_left
    assumption

name: List.and_foldl_eq_foldl
statement:
theorem List.and_foldl_eq_foldl (a : ℕ) (orig : ℕ) (l : List ℕ) :
    a &&& List.foldl (· &&& ·) orig l = List.foldl (· &&& ·) (a &&& orig) l
proof:
:= by
  induction l generalizing orig with
  | nil =>
    simp only [List.foldl_nil]
  | cons hd tl ih =>
    simp only [List.foldl_cons]
    rw [ih (orig &&& hd)]
    congr 1
    simp only [HAnd.hAnd, AndOp.and]
    show a &&& (orig &&& hd) = (a &&& orig) &&& hd
    exact (Nat.land_assoc a orig hd).symm

name: toBits_fromBits_aux
statement:
lemma toBits_fromBits_aux {n : ℕ} (bits : Vector ℕ n)
  (h_bits : ∀ (i : ℕ) (hi : i < n), bits[i] = 0 ∨ bits[i] = 1) :
    (fromBits bits) < 2^n ∧ toBits n (fromBits bits) = bits
proof:
:= by
  rw [Vector.ext_iff]
  simp only [fromBits, toBits, Vector.getElem_mapRange]
  induction n with
  | zero => simp_all
  | succ n ih =>
    simp only [Fin.foldl_succ_last, Fin.val_castSucc, Fin.val_last]
    let bits' : Vector ℕ n := bits.pop
    have h_bits' : ∀ j (hj : j < n), bits'[j] = 0 ∨ bits'[j] = 1
      | j, hj => by
        simp only [Vector.getElem_pop', bits']
        exact h_bits j (Nat.lt_succ_of_lt hj)

    have h_bits_n : bits[n] = 0 ∨ bits[n] = 1 := h_bits n (Nat.lt_succ_self _)
    obtain ⟨ ih_lt, ih_eq ⟩ := ih bits' h_bits'

    simp only [Vector.getElem_pop', bits'] at ih_eq ih_lt

    let xn : ℕ := Fin.foldl n (fun acc ⟨i, _⟩ => acc + bits[i] * (2 ^ i)) 0
    have : bits[n] ≤ 1 := by rcases h_bits_n <;> simp only [zero_le, le_refl, *]
    have h_lt : xn + bits[n] * 2^n < 2^(n+1) := by
      have : bits[n] * 2^n ≤ 1 * 2^n := Nat.mul_le_mul_right (2 ^ n) (by linarith)
      rw [Nat.pow_succ']
      linarith

    constructor
    · exact h_lt
    · intro i hi
      rw [mul_comm _ (2^n), add_comm _ (2^n * _), Nat.testBit_two_pow_mul_add _ ih_lt]
      by_cases hin : i < n <;> simp only [hin, reduceIte]
      · exact ih_eq i hin
      · have : n = i := by linarith
        subst this
        rcases h_bits_n <;> simp [*]

name: toBits_fromBits
statement:
theorem toBits_fromBits {n : ℕ} (bits : Vector ℕ n)
  (h_bits : ∀ (i : ℕ) (hi : i < n), bits[i] = 0 ∨ bits[i] = 1) :
    toBits n (fromBits bits) = bits
proof: := (toBits_fromBits_aux bits h_bits).right

name: fromBits_lt
statement:
theorem fromBits_lt {n : ℕ} (bits : Vector ℕ n)
  (h_bits : ∀ (i : ℕ) (hi : i < n), bits[i] = 0 ∨ bits[i] = 1) :
    (fromBits bits) < 2^n
proof: := (toBits_fromBits_aux bits h_bits).left

name: toBits_injective
statement:
theorem toBits_injective (n : ℕ) {x y : ℕ} : x < 2^n → y < 2^n →
    toBits n x = toBits n y → x = y
proof:
:= by
  intro hx hy h_eq
  rw [Vector.ext_iff] at h_eq
  simp only [toBits, Vector.getElem_mapRange] at h_eq
  have h_eq' : ∀ i (hi : i < n), x.testBit i = y.testBit i := by
    intro i hi
    specialize h_eq i hi
    by_cases hx_i : x.testBit i <;> by_cases hy_i : y.testBit i <;>
      simp_all

  apply Nat.eq_of_testBit_eq
  intro i
  by_cases hi : i < n
  · exact h_eq' i hi
  · have : n ≤ i := by linarith
    have : 2^n ≤ 2^i := Nat.pow_le_pow_of_le (a:=2) (by norm_num) this
    replace hx : x < 2^i := by linarith
    replace hy : y < 2^i := by linarith
    rw [Nat.testBit_lt_two_pow hx, Nat.testBit_lt_two_pow hy]

name: fromBits_toBits
statement:
theorem fromBits_toBits {n : ℕ} {x : ℕ} (hx : x < 2^n) :
    fromBits (toBits n x) = x
proof:
:= by
  have h_bits : ∀ i (hi : i < n), (toBits n x)[i] = 0 ∨ (toBits n x)[i] = 1 := by
    intro i hi; simp [toBits, Vector.getElem_mapRange]
  apply toBits_injective n (fromBits_lt _ h_bits) hx
  rw [toBits_fromBits _ h_bits]

name: fromBits_toBits_mod
statement: theorem fromBits_toBits_mod {n : ℕ} {x : ℕ} : fromBits (toBits n x) = x % 2^n
proof:
:= by
  
  have h_fromBits_toBits : ∀ (x : ℕ) (n : ℕ), fromBits (toBits n x) = ∑ i ∈ Finset.range n, (x / 2^i) % 2 * 2^i := by
    intros x n
    simp only [fromBits, toBits];
    simp +decide only [Finset.sum_range];
    convert Fin.foldl_to_sum n _ using 2 ; simp +decide [Nat.testBit];
    simp +decide only [Nat.shiftRight_eq_div_pow, Vector.getElem_mapRange];
    cases Nat.mod_two_eq_zero_or_one (x / 2^(↑‹Fin n› : ℕ) ) <;> simp +decide [*];
  induction n <;> simp_all +decide [Finset.sum_range_succ, pow_succ]
  · rw [Nat.mod_one]
  · rw [←Nat.mod_add_div x (2 ^ _)] ; simp +decide [Nat.add_mod]
    norm_num [Nat.add_div, Nat.add_mod, Nat.mul_div_assoc, Nat.mul_mod, Nat.pow_succ']
    swap
    · rename_i pred ih
      exact pred + 1
    norm_num [Nat.pow_succ, Nat.mul_mod_mul_left, Nat.mod_eq_of_lt]
    split_ifs <;> simp_all +decide [Nat.mul_assoc];
    · linarith [Nat.mod_lt x (show 2 ^ ‹_› > 0 by positivity)]
    · rename_i pred ih h_lt
      rw [← Nat.mod_add_div (x % (2 ^ pred * 2) ) (2 ^ pred)]
      rw [Nat.add_mul_div_left _ _ (by positivity)]; norm_num
      rw [Nat.mod_eq_of_lt (show x % (2 ^ _ * 2)/2 ^ _ < 2 from Nat.div_lt_of_lt_mul <| by linarith [Nat.mod_lt x (by positivity : 0 < (2 ^ ‹_› * 2))])]
      ring

name: getElem_fieldToBits
statement:
lemma getElem_fieldToBits {n : ℕ} (x : F p) (i : ℕ) (hi : i < n) :
    (fieldToBits n x)[i] = ((x.val >>> i % 2 : ℕ) : F p)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [fieldToBits, toBits, Vector.getElem_map, Vector.getElem_mapRange,
    Nat.testBit_eq_decide_div_mod_eq, Nat.shiftRight_eq_div_pow]
  rcases Nat.mod_two_eq_zero_or_one (x.val / 2^i) with h | h <;> simp [h]

name: fieldFromBits_eval
statement:
theorem fieldFromBits_eval {n : ℕ} {eval : Environment (F p)} (bits : Vector (Expression (F p)) n) :
    eval (fieldFromBitsExpr bits) = fieldFromBits (bits.map eval)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [fieldFromBitsExpr, fieldFromBits, fromBits]
  induction n with
  | zero => simp only [Fin.foldl_zero, Expression.eval, Vector.map_map, Vector.getElem_map,
    Function.comp_apply, Nat.cast_zero]
  | succ n ih =>
    obtain ih := ih bits.pop
    simp [Vector.getElem_pop'] at ih
    simp [Fin.foldl_succ_last, ih, Expression.eval]

name: fieldToBits_bits
statement:
theorem fieldToBits_bits {n : ℕ} {x : F p} :
    ∀ i (_ : i < n), (fieldToBits n x)[i] = 0 ∨ (fieldToBits n x)[i] = 1
proof:
:= by
  simp [fieldToBits, toBits, Vector.getElem_mapRange]

name: fieldToBits_fieldFromBits_aux
statement:
lemma fieldToBits_fieldFromBits_aux {n : ℕ} (hn : 2^n < p) (bits : Vector (F p) n)
  (h_bits : ∀ (i : ℕ) (hi : i < n), bits[i] = 0 ∨ bits[i] = 1) :
    (fieldFromBits bits).val < 2^n ∧ fieldToBits n (fieldFromBits bits) = bits
proof:
:= by
  rw [Vector.ext_iff]
  simp only [fieldFromBits, fieldToBits]

  have h_bool : ∀ i (hi : i < n), (bits.map ZMod.val)[i] = 0 ∨ (bits.map ZMod.val)[i] = 1 := by
    intro i hi
    specialize h_bits i hi
    apply Or.elim h_bits
    · intro h; apply Or.inl; simp only [Vector.getElem_map, ZMod.val_eq_zero]; assumption
    · intro h; apply Or.inr; simp only [Vector.getElem_map]
      apply_fun ZMod.val at h
      simp only [ZMod.val_one] at h
      exact h

  obtain ⟨thm_lt, thm_val⟩ := toBits_fromBits_aux (bits.map ZMod.val) h_bool
  constructor
  · rw [ZMod.val_natCast_of_lt (by linarith)]
    exact thm_lt
  · intro i hi
    simp
    have h_lt : fromBits (Vector.map ZMod.val bits) < p := by linarith
    simp_rw [Nat.mod_eq_of_lt h_lt, thm_val]
    simp

name: fieldFromBits_lt
statement:
theorem fieldFromBits_lt {n : ℕ} (bits : Vector (F p) n)
  (h_bits : ∀ (i : ℕ) (hi : i < n), bits[i] = 0 ∨ bits[i] = 1) :
    (fieldFromBits bits).val < 2^n
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hn : 2^n < p
  · exact (fieldToBits_fieldFromBits_aux hn bits h_bits).left
  have : p ≤ 2^n := Nat.le_of_not_lt hn
  have : (fieldFromBits bits).val < p := ZMod.val_lt _
  linarith

name: fieldToBits_fieldFromBits
statement:
theorem fieldToBits_fieldFromBits {n : ℕ} (hn : 2^n < p) (bits : Vector (F p) n)
  (h_bits : ∀ (i : ℕ) (hi : i < n), bits[i] = 0 ∨ bits[i] = 1) :
    fieldToBits n (fieldFromBits bits) = bits
proof: := (fieldToBits_fieldFromBits_aux hn bits h_bits).right

name: fieldToBits_injective
statement:
theorem fieldToBits_injective (n : ℕ) {x y : F p} : x.val < 2^n → y.val < 2^n →
    fieldToBits n x = fieldToBits n y → x = y
proof:
:= by
  intro hx hy h_eq
  simp only [fieldToBits] at h_eq
  rw [Vector.ext_iff] at h_eq
  simp only [toBits, Vector.getElem_map, Vector.getElem_mapRange, Nat.cast_ite, Nat.cast_one,
    Nat.cast_zero] at h_eq

  have h_eq' : ∀ i (hi : i < n), x.val.testBit i = y.val.testBit i := by
    intro i hi
    specialize h_eq i hi
    by_cases hx_i : x.val.testBit i <;> by_cases hy_i : y.val.testBit i <;>
      simp_all
  apply FieldUtils.ext
  apply Nat.eq_of_testBit_eq
  intro i
  by_cases hi : i < n
  · exact h_eq' i hi
  have : n ≤ i := by linarith
  have : 2^n ≤ 2^i := Nat.pow_le_pow_of_le (a:=2) (by norm_num) this
  replace hx : x.val < 2^i := by linarith
  replace hy : y.val < 2^i := by linarith
  rw [Nat.testBit_lt_two_pow hx, Nat.testBit_lt_two_pow hy]

name: val_natCast_toBits
statement:
lemma val_natCast_toBits {n} {x : ℕ} :
    Vector.map (ZMod.val ∘ Nat.cast (R:=F p)) (toBits n x) = toBits n x
proof:
:= by
  rw [Vector.ext_iff]
  intro i hi
  simp only [Vector.getElem_map, Function.comp_apply]
  rw [ZMod.val_natCast, Nat.mod_eq_of_lt]
  simp only [toBits, Vector.getElem_mapRange]
  split
  · exact prime.elim.one_lt
  · exact prime.elim.pos

name: fieldFromBits_fieldToBits
statement:
theorem fieldFromBits_fieldToBits {n : ℕ} {x : F p} (hx : x.val < 2^n) :
    fieldFromBits (fieldToBits n x) = x
proof:
:= by
  simp only [fieldToBits, fieldFromBits]
  rw [Vector.map_map, val_natCast_toBits, fromBits_toBits hx, ZMod.natCast_zmod_val]

name: fieldFromBits_fieldToBits_mod
statement:
theorem fieldFromBits_fieldToBits_mod {n : ℕ} (x : F p) :
    fieldFromBits (fieldToBits n x) = ((x.val % 2^n : ℕ) : F p)
proof:
:= by
  convert fromBits_toBits_mod (n:=n) (x:=x.val);
  unfold fieldFromBits fieldToBits;
  simp_all only [Vector.map_map]
  apply Iff.intro
  · intro a; exact fromBits_toBits_mod (x:=ZMod.val x)
  · intro a; congr; convert a using 2; exact val_natCast_toBits

name: fieldFromBits_succ
statement:
lemma fieldFromBits_succ (n : ℕ) (bits : Vector (F p) (n + 1)) :
    fieldFromBits bits = fieldFromBits bits.pop + bits[n] * (2^n : F p)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [fieldFromBits, fromBits, Vector.getElem_map, Fin.foldl_succ_last, Fin.val_castSucc,
    Fin.val_last, Nat.add_one_sub_one, Vector.getElem_pop']
  rw [Nat.cast_add, Nat.cast_mul, ZMod.natCast_zmod_val, Nat.cast_pow]
  rfl

name: fieldFromBits_as_sum
statement:
lemma fieldFromBits_as_sum {n : ℕ} (bits : Vector (F p) n) :
    fieldFromBits bits =
    Fin.foldl n (fun acc k => acc + bits[k.val] * (2^k.val : F p)) 0
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero => simp [fieldFromBits, fromBits, Fin.foldl_zero]
  | succ n ih => simp [fieldFromBits_succ, ih, Fin.foldl_succ_last]

name: fieldFromBits_eq
statement:
lemma fieldFromBits_eq {n : ℕ} {xs ys : Vector (F p) n} (h: ∀ (i : Fin n), xs[↑i] = ys[↑i]) :
    fieldFromBits xs = fieldFromBits ys
proof:
:= by
  have h_vec_eq : xs = ys := by
    ext i h_range
    let fi : Fin n := ⟨i, h_range⟩
    exact h fi
  rw [h_vec_eq]

name: fieldFromBits_eq_mapFinRange_cast
statement:
lemma fieldFromBits_eq_mapFinRange_cast {n} {f : Fin n → F p} :
    fieldFromBits (Vector.mapFinRange n f) = (fromBits (Vector.mapFinRange n fun i => (f i).val) : F p)
proof:
:= by
  unfold fieldFromBits
  apply congrArg (Nat.cast : ℕ → F p)
  apply congrArg fromBits
  ext i
  simp only [Vector.getElem_map, Vector.getElem_mapFinRange]

name: zero_ne_neg_one
statement:
@[circuit_norm]
lemma zero_ne_neg_one {F : Type} [Field F] : (0 : F) ≠ -1
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  apply zero_ne_one (α:=F)
  rw [← neg_zero, h, neg_neg]

name: p_ne_zero
statement: theorem p_ne_zero : p ≠ 0
proof: := p_prime.elim.ne_zero

name: ext
statement: theorem ext {x y : F p} (h : x.val = y.val) : x = y
proof:
:= by
  cases p; cases p_ne_zero rfl
  exact Fin.ext h

name: ext_iff
statement: theorem ext_iff {x y : F p} : x = y ↔ x.val = y.val
proof:
:= by
  constructor; simp_all; apply ext

name: val_lt_p
statement: theorem val_lt_p {p : ℕ} (x : ℕ) : (x < p) → (x : F p).val = x
proof:
:= by
  intro x_lt_p
  have p_ne_zero : p ≠ 0 := Nat.ne_zero_of_lt x_lt_p
  have x_mod_is_x : x % p = x := (Nat.mod_eq_iff_lt p_ne_zero).mpr x_lt_p
  rw [ZMod.val_natCast, x_mod_is_x]

name: val_eq_256
statement: lemma val_eq_256 [p_large_enough: Fact (p > 512)] : (256 : F p).val = 256
proof: := val_lt_p 256 (by linarith [p_large_enough.elim])

name: natToField_zero
statement: theorem natToField_zero : natToField 0 (p_prime.elim.pos) = 0
proof:
:= by
  dsimp [natToField]
  cases p
  · exact False.elim (Nat.not_lt_zero 0 p_prime.elim.pos)
  · rfl

name: natToField_eq
statement: theorem natToField_eq {n : ℕ} {lt : n < p} (x : F p) (hx : x = natToField n lt) : x.val = n
proof:
:= by
  cases p
  · exact False.elim (Nat.not_lt_zero n lt)
  · rw [hx]; rfl

name: natToField_of_val_eq_iff
statement: theorem natToField_of_val_eq_iff {x : F p} {lt : x.val < p} : natToField (x.val) lt = x
proof:
:= by
  cases p
  · exact False.elim (Nat.not_lt_zero x.val lt)
  · dsimp only [natToField]; rfl

name: natToField_eq_natCast
statement: theorem natToField_eq_natCast {n : ℕ} (lt : n < p) : ↑n = FieldUtils.natToField n lt
proof:
:= by
  apply ext
  rw [val_lt_p n lt, natToField_eq _ rfl]

name: natToField_val
statement: theorem natToField_val {n : ℕ} (lt : n < p) : (natToField n lt).val = n
proof:
:= by
  cases p
  · exact False.elim (Nat.not_lt_zero n lt)
  · rfl

name: less_than_p
statement: theorem less_than_p (x : F p) : x.val < p
proof:
:= by
  rcases p with _ | n; cases p_ne_zero rfl
  exact x.is_lt

name: natCast_val
statement:
@[circuit_norm, grind =]
lemma natCast_val (a : F p) : (a.val : F p) = a
proof: := ZMod.natCast_zmod_val _

name: fin_val_natCast_val_lt
statement:
@[circuit_norm, grind .]
lemma fin_val_natCast_val_lt {p : ℕ} {n : ℕ} (x : Fin n) : (x.val : F p).val < n
proof:
:= by
  grw [ZMod.val_natCast, Nat.mod_le]
  exact x.isLt

name: fin_val_natCast_val_eq_of_lt
statement:
@[grind =]
lemma fin_val_natCast_val_eq_of_lt {p : ℕ} {n : ℕ} (x : Fin n) (hn : n < p) : (x.val : F p).val = x.val
proof:
:= by
  rw [ZMod.val_natCast_of_lt (a := x.val)]
  linarith [hn, x.isLt]

name: mod_val
statement: lemma mod_val {x : F p} {c : ℕ+} {lt : c < p} : (mod x c lt).val = x.val % c
proof:
:= by
  rw [mod, ZMod.val_natCast_of_lt]
  grw [Nat.mod_lt x.val c.pos]
  exact lt.le

name: floorDiv_val
statement: lemma floorDiv_val {x : F p} {c : ℕ+} : (floorDiv x c).val = x.val / c
proof:
:= by
  rw [floorDiv, ZMod.val_natCast_of_lt]
  grw [Nat.div_le_self]
  apply ZMod.val_lt

name: mod_lt
statement: theorem mod_lt {x : F p} {c : ℕ+} {lt : c < p} : (mod x c lt).val < c
proof:
:= by
  rw [mod_val]
  exact Nat.mod_lt x.val (by norm_num)

name: floorDiv_lt
statement: theorem floorDiv_lt {x : F p} {c : ℕ+} {d : ℕ} (h : x.val < c * d) : (floorDiv x c).val < d
proof:
:= by
  rw [floorDiv_val]
  exact Nat.div_lt_of_lt_mul h

name: val_mul_floorDiv_self
statement: lemma val_mul_floorDiv_self {x : F p} {c : ℕ+} (lt : c < p) : (c * (floorDiv x c)).val = c * (x.val / c)
proof:
:= by
  rcases p with _ | n; cases p_ne_zero rfl
  have : c * (x.val / c) ≤ x.val := Nat.mul_div_le (ZMod.val x) ↑c
  have h : x.val < n + 1 := x.is_lt
  rw [ZMod.val_mul, ZMod.val_cast_of_lt lt,
    floorDiv_val, Nat.mod_eq_of_lt (by linarith)]

name: mod_add_floorDiv
statement:
theorem mod_add_floorDiv {x : F p} {c : ℕ+} (lt : c < p) :
    mod x c lt + c * (floorDiv x c) = x
proof:
:= by
  rcases p with _ | n; cases p_ne_zero rfl
  have h : x.val < n + 1 := x.is_lt
  apply ext
  suffices x.val % c + (c * (floorDiv x c)).val = x.val by
    rw [← mod_val (lt := lt)] at this
    rwa [ZMod.val_add_of_lt]
    rwa [this]
  rw [val_mul_floorDiv_self lt, Nat.mod_add_div x.val c]

name: mul_val_of_dvd
statement:
theorem mul_val_of_dvd {x c : F p} :
    c.val ∣ (c * x).val → (c * x).val = c.val * x.val
proof:
:= by
  by_cases c_pos? : c = 0
  · subst c_pos?; simp
  intro ⟨x', h_eq⟩
  have h_lt : c.val * x' < p := by
    rw [←h_eq]
    apply ZMod.val_lt
  have c_pos : c.val > 0 := ZMod.val_pos.mpr c_pos?
  have x'_lt : x' < p := calc x'
    _ = 1 * x' := by ring
    _ ≤ c.val * x' := by apply Nat.mul_le_mul_right x' (Nat.succ_le_of_lt c_pos)
    _ < p := h_lt
  let x'_f : F p := natToField x' x'_lt
  have x'_val_eq : x'_f.val = x' := natToField_eq x'_f rfl
  have cx_val_eq : (c * x'_f).val = c.val * x' := by
    rw [←x'_val_eq]
    apply ZMod.val_mul_of_lt
    rw [x'_val_eq]
    exact h_lt
  rw [←cx_val_eq] at h_eq
  obtain h_eq := ext h_eq
  rw [mul_right_inj' c_pos?] at h_eq
  rw [h_eq, x'_val_eq, cx_val_eq]

name: mul_nat_val_of_dvd
statement:
theorem mul_nat_val_of_dvd {x : F p} (c : ℕ) (c_lt : c < p) {z : ℕ} :
    (c * x).val = c * z → (c * x).val = c * x.val
proof:
:= by
  have c_val_eq : c = (c : F p).val := by rw [ZMod.val_cast_of_lt c_lt]
  rw (occs := .pos [2, 4]) [c_val_eq]
  intro h_dvd
  exact mul_val_of_dvd ⟨ z, h_dvd ⟩

name: mul_nat_val_eq_iff
statement:
theorem mul_nat_val_eq_iff {x : F p} (c : ℕ) (c_pos : c > 0) (c_lt : c < p) {z : ℕ} :
    (c * x).val = c * z ↔ (x.val = z ∧ c * x.val < p)
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h_dvd
    constructor
    · apply (mul_right_inj' (Nat.ne_zero_iff_zero_lt.mpr c_pos)).mp
      rw [←h_dvd, mul_nat_val_of_dvd c c_lt h_dvd]
    · rw [←mul_nat_val_of_dvd c c_lt h_dvd]
      apply ZMod.val_lt
  · intro ⟨ h_eq, h_lt ⟩
    have c_val_eq : c = (c : F p).val := by rw [ZMod.val_cast_of_lt c_lt]
    rw [←h_eq, ZMod.val_mul_of_lt, ←c_val_eq]
    rw [←c_val_eq]
    exact h_lt

name: two_lt
statement: lemma two_lt : 2 < p
proof:
:= by
  linarith [‹Fact (p > 512)›.elim]

name: two_val
statement: lemma two_val : (2 : F p).val = 2
proof:
:=
  FieldUtils.val_lt_p 2 two_lt

name: two_pow_lt
statement: lemma two_pow_lt (n : ℕ) (hn : n ≤ 8) : 2^n < p
proof:
:= by
  have h : 2^n ≤ 2^8 := Nat.pow_le_pow_of_le (a:=2) Nat.one_lt_ofNat hn
  linarith [‹Fact (p > 512)›.elim]

name: two_pow_val
statement: lemma two_pow_val (n : ℕ) (hn : n ≤ 8) : (2^n : F p).val = 2^n
proof:
:= by
  rw [ZMod.val_pow, two_val]
  rw [two_val]
  exact two_pow_lt _ hn

name: neg_one_ne_one
statement:
@[circuit_norm]
lemma neg_one_ne_one :
    ¬(-1 : F p) = 1
proof:
:= by
  intro h_eq
  suffices h : (1 : F p) + 1 = 0 by
    replace h := congrArg ZMod.val h
    rw [ZMod.val_add] at h
    simp [ZMod.val_one, Nat.mod_eq_of_lt gt2.elim] at h
  nth_rw 1 [← h_eq]
  ring

name: one_ne_neg_one
statement:
@[circuit_norm]
lemma one_ne_neg_one : ¬(1 : F p) = -1
proof:
:=
  fun h => neg_one_ne_one h.symm

name: mod256_lt
statement: theorem mod256_lt [Fact (p > 512)] (x : F p) : (mod256 x).val < 256
proof: := mod_lt

name: floorDiv256_bool
statement:
theorem floorDiv256_bool [Fact (p > 512)] {x : F p} (h : x.val < 512) :
    floorDiv x 256 = 0 ∨ floorDiv x 256 = 1
proof:
:= by
  rcases p with _ | n; cases p_ne_zero rfl
  let z := x.val / 256
  have : z < 2 := Nat.div_lt_of_lt_mul h
  
  rcases (Nat.lt_trichotomy z 1) with _ | h1 | _
  · left; apply ext; rw [floorDiv_val]; show z = 0; linarith
  · right; apply ext; rw [floorDiv_val, ZMod.val_one]; exact h1
  · linarith

name: mod_add_div256
statement: theorem mod_add_div256 [Fact (p > 512)] (x : F p) : mod256 x + 256 * floorDiv x 256 = x
proof:
:= by
  apply FieldUtils.mod_add_floorDiv (c:=256)

name: splitTwoBytes_concatTwoBytes
statement: theorem splitTwoBytes_concatTwoBytes (x y : Fin 256) : splitTwoBytes (concatTwoBytes x y) = (x, y)
proof:
:= by
  dsimp [splitTwoBytes, concatTwoBytes]
  ext
  simp only
  rw [mul_comm]
  have h := Nat.mul_add_div (by norm_num : 256 > 0) x.val y.val
  rw [h]
  simp
  simp only [Nat.mul_add_mod_of_lt y.is_lt]

name: byte_sum_do_not_wrap
statement:
theorem byte_sum_do_not_wrap (x y : F p) [Fact (p > 512)]:
    x.val < 256 -> y.val < 256 -> (x + y).val = x.val + y.val
proof: := by field_to_nat

name: byte_sum_le_bound
statement:
theorem byte_sum_le_bound (x y : F p) [Fact (p > 512)]:
    x.val < 256 -> y.val < 256 -> (x + y).val < 511
proof: := by field_to_nat

name: byte_sum_and_bit_do_not_wrap
statement:
theorem byte_sum_and_bit_do_not_wrap (x y b : F p) [Fact (p > 512)]:
    x.val < 256 -> y.val < 256 -> b.val < 2 -> (b + x + y).val = b.val + x.val + y.val
proof: := by field_to_nat

name: byte_sum_and_bit_do_not_wrap'
statement:
theorem byte_sum_and_bit_do_not_wrap' (x y b : F p) [Fact (p > 512)]:
    x.val < 256 -> y.val < 256 -> b.val < 2 -> (x + y + b).val = x.val + y.val + b.val
proof: := by field_to_nat

name: byte_sum_and_bit_lt_512
statement:
theorem byte_sum_and_bit_lt_512 (x y b : F p) [Fact (p > 512)]:
    x.val < 256 -> y.val < 256 -> b.val < 2 -> (x + y + b).val < 512

name: byte_plus_256_do_not_wrap

theorem byte_plus_256_do_not_wrap (x : F p) [Fact (p > 512)]:
    x.val < 256 -> (x + 256).val = x.val + 256

name: fromByte_lt
statement: lemma fromByte_lt (x : Fin 256) : (fromByte (p:=p) x).val < 256
proof:
:= by
  dsimp [fromByte]
  rw [natToField_val]
  exact x.is_lt

name: fromByte_eq
statement: lemma fromByte_eq (x : F p) (x_lt : x.val < 256) : fromByte ⟨ x.val, x_lt ⟩ = x
proof:
:= by
  dsimp [fromByte]
  apply FieldUtils.natToField_of_val_eq_iff

name: cast_apply
statement:
theorem cast_apply {α β β' : Type} (h : β = β') (f : α → β) (x : α) :
    (cast (h ▸ rfl) f : α → β') x = cast (h ▸ rfl) (f x)
proof:
:= by
  subst h; rfl

name: cast_apply'
statement:
theorem cast_apply' {α α' β : Type} (h : α = α') (f : α → β) (x : α') :
    (cast (h ▸ rfl) f : α' → β) x = f (cast (h ▸ rfl) x : α)
proof:
:= by
  subst h; rfl

name: cast_fst
statement:
theorem cast_fst {α α' β : Type} (h : α = α') (p : α × β) :
    (cast h p.1 : α') = (cast (h ▸ rfl) p : α' × β).1
proof:
:= by
  subst h; rfl

name: cast_snd
statement:
theorem cast_snd {α β β' : Type} (h : β = β') (p : α × β) :
    (cast h p.2 : β') = (cast (h ▸ rfl) p : α × β').2
proof:
:= by
  subst h; rfl

name: fst_cast
statement:
theorem fst_cast {α β β' : Type} (h : β = β') (p : α × β) :
    (cast (h ▸ rfl) p : α × β').1 = p.1
proof:
:= by
  subst h; rfl

name: snd_cast
statement:
theorem snd_cast {α α' β : Type} (h : α = α') (p : α × β) :
    (cast (h ▸ rfl) p : α' × β).2 = p.2
proof:
:= by
  subst h; rfl

name: Fin.foldl_const_succ
statement:
theorem Fin.foldl_const_succ (n : ℕ) (f : Fin (n + 1) → α) (init : α) :
    Fin.foldl (n + 1) (fun _ i => f i) init = f (.last n)
proof:
:= by
  induction n generalizing init with
  | zero =>
      simp only [Nat.zero_add, Nat.reduceAdd, cast_eq_self, last_zero, isValue, foldl_succ]
      aesop
  | succ n ih =>
    let f' (i : Fin (n + 1)) := f (i.succ)
    rw [Fin.foldl_succ]
    show Fin.foldl (n + 1) (fun x i ↦ f' i) _ = _
    rw [ih]
    simp only [f']
    rw [Fin.succ_last, ←Fin.natCast_eq_last]

name: Fin.foldl_const_zero
statement:
theorem Fin.foldl_const_zero (f : Fin 0 → α) (init : α) :
    Fin.foldl 0 (fun _ i => f i) init = init
proof: := by aesop

name: Fin.foldl_const
statement:
theorem Fin.foldl_const (n : ℕ) (f : Fin n → α) (init : α) :
  Fin.foldl n (fun _ i => f i) init = match n with
    | 0 => init
    | n + 1 => f (.last n)
proof:
:= by
  split <;> simp [foldl_const_succ]

name: MemoryAccessList.addressTimestampSort_sorted
statement:
theorem MemoryAccessList.addressTimestampSort_sorted (accesses : MemoryAccessList) :
    (MemoryAccessList.addressTimestampSort accesses).Pairwise address_timestamp_ordering

name: MemoryAccessList.addressTimestampSort_perm
statement:
theorem MemoryAccessList.addressTimestampSort_perm (accesses : MemoryAccessList) :
    (MemoryAccessList.addressTimestampSort accesses).Perm accesses

:= by
